tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /swā khyā taṃ la k+ṣa ṇa s+si dhā n+ta sa r+b+ba dzña nā ma he tu pā ra mi tā yā yā na s+ya si d+dhā n+ta tsa tu r+ṇāṃ bya ba s+d+yā na kā shaṃ de sha na sbi dza hā raṃ/ ༄༅/ /rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa'i grub mtha' bzhi'i rnam gzhag gsal bar bstan pa legs par bshad pa mtshan nyid grub mtha' kun shes zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bud+dha dh+wa dzā ya/ dang por thugs bskyed bar du tshogs gnyis bsags/ /sgrib gnyis spangs pas bdud dpung kun bcom nas/ /rdo rje gdan du mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i/ /ston mchog zas gtsang sras pos bdag skyongs shig /de gsung lung rtogs bdag nyid dam pa'i chos/ /rgyal sras bstan 'dzin 'phags pa'i dge 'dun sogs/ /skyabs gnas bslu med thams cad 'dus pa'i dngos/ /kho bo'i 'dren pa mchog rnams phyag gi gnas/ /gzhan yang sa skya'i bla chen yab sras lnga/ /gang de'i bstan 'dzin rim par byon rnams la/ /gus pas btud nas mtshan nyid theg pa yi/ /grub mtha' rnam bzhi'i rnam gzhag bshad kyis nyon/ /ces mchod par brjod cing / bshad par dam bcas nas/ 'dir rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa'i grub mtha' bzhi'i rnam gzhag gsal bar bstan pa legs par bshad pa mtshan nyid grub mtha' kun shes zhes bya ba 'di 'chad pa la spyi don rnam pa bzhi ste/ bye brag tu smra ba'i grub mtha' bshad pa/ mdo sde pa'i grub mtha' bshad pa/ sems tsam pa'i grub mtha' bshad pa/ dbu ma pa'i grub mtha' bshad pa'o/ /de'i dang po la gnyis te/ tshigs bcad kyi sgo nas mdor bstan pa dang / de'i don rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ rnyed dka'i dal 'byor rin chen thob dus 'dir/ /shes bya'i gnas kun sbyangs zhes mkhas rnams gsungs/ /de phyir 'dir ni pha rol phyin pa yi/ /grub mtha' rnam bzhi'i gzhung lugs kun rig phyir/ /thog mar bye brag smra gzhung nges bya ste/ /shes bya'i gnas ni phung po skye mched khams/ /sum cu rtsa lnga chos gnyis kyis bsdus pa/

/de yang gzugs sems sems las byung ba dang / /mi ldan 'du byed 'dus ma byas te lnga/ /gzugs kyi khams na gzugs rdzas nyung mtha' drug /lus dbang ldan la bdun dang gzhan ldan brgyad/ /'dod na dri ro yod phyir nyung mtha' drug /lus dbang dbang gzhan ldan na rdzas bcu ste/ /sgra dang ldan par skye na bcu gcig go /sems ni rnam par shes pa'i tshogs drug ste/ /de yang gzung 'dzin tha dad dus mnyam pa/ /rnam pas bar du ma bsgribs thug phrad 'dzin/ /sems las byung ba sems kyi sa mang dang / /dge dang nyon mongs chung rnams bcu tshan re/ /nyon mongs che drug mi dge'i sa pa gnyis/ /ma nges brgyad dang bcas pas bzhi bcu drug /brjed ngas rnam g.yeng dran dang ting nge 'dzin/ /nyon mongs can rdzas yin phyir de gnyis dang / /gti mug med dang lta ba shes bzhin min/ /shes rab rdzas yin phyi na lnga bcu gcig /sems dang sems byung rnam med rdzas grub ste/ /bdag rkyen dbang po dang bcas shes pa yis/ /yul rnams rig pa gzhan rig kho nar 'dod/ /mi ldan 'du byed thob dang ma thob dang / /skal mnyam 'du shes med dang snyoms 'jug gnyis/ /srog dang skye gnas rga ba mi rtag pa/ /ming tshig yi ge'i tshogs te bcu bzhi 'o/ /nam mkha' gzugs can go 'byed rdzas su yod/ /so sor brtag 'gog gnyen po shes rab kyis/ /spang bya zag bcas bcom pa'i bral rdzas te/ /brtags min 'gog pa rkyen rnams ma tshang ba/ /chos 'ga' skye la gegs byed 'gog gzhan rdzas/ /de bzhin dus gsum dag kyang rdzas su 'dod/ /lam bden ma gtogs 'dus byas zag bcas te/ /zag rnams rgyas par 'gyur phyir sdug kun gnyis/ /'bras bu sdug bsngal bden pa snod dang bcud/ /de'i rgyu kun 'byung las dang nyon mongs gnyis/ /las kyi kun 'byung sems pa dang des byas/ /sems pa yid kyi las yin bsam pa ni/ /des bskyed lus dang ngag gi las rnams te/ /nyon mongs kun 'byung rtsa nyon nye nyon no/

/lam gyi dmigs pa sdug kun 'gog lam bzhi/ /shes bya spang bya rig bya bsten bya ste/ /mi rtag sdug bsngal stong dang bdag med pa/ /rgyu dang kun 'byung rab tu skye ba rkyen/ /'gog pa zhi ba gya nom nges par 'byung / /lam dang rig pa sgrub pa nges 'byin du/ /'phags pas nges phyir 'phags pa'i bden par brjod/ /bcom dang cha shas bsal bas der 'dzin gyi/ /blo mi 'jug pa bum chu sogs kun rdzob/ /bcom dang bsal yang de yi blo 'jug pa/ /phra rab rdul dang skad cig sogs don dam/ /bden pa'i mngon rtogs thog mar tshul khrims bsrung / /de yis thos bsam sngon song zhi gnas bsgrub/ /de nas lhag mthong bskyed phyir lam lngar 'jug /tshogs kyi lam du dran pa nyer gzhag bzhi/ /mtshan nyid gnyis su shes rab kyis brtags te/ /dran pas dmigs pa dag la gtod par byed/ /de lta'i chos dran goms pas bden pa la/ /zhi lhag zung sbrel snang ba phra thob nas/ /'phags lam snga ltas dge rtsa drod thob de'i/ /dmigs rnam bden bzhi mi rtag la sogs ldan/ /de tshe yang dag spong ba brtson 'grus bsgom/ /drod gsum rim bzhin goms pas bden pa la/ /dmigs pa'i zung 'brel rim gyis 'phel ba las/ /dge rtsa g.yo ba'i rtse thob de'i dmigs rnam/ /snga ma dang mtshungs rdzu 'phrul rkang bzhi bsgom/ /rtse mo rnam gsum 'phel las bden pa yi/ /chos nyid cha shas mthong la mi skrag pa'i/ /bzod pa gsum skye de yi chung 'bring gi /rnam pa sngar dang mtshungs te chos dran gyi/ /dmigs pa bden pa dag la gtod phyir ro/ /chen po 'dod gtogs sdug bsngal la dmigs pa'i/ /skad cig gcig yin dbang po lnga bsgom bya/ /de nas rgyu gzhan med par rang stobs kyis/ /'phags lam 'dren byed chos kyi mchog skye ste/ /dmigs rnam bzod chen dang mtshungs stobs lnga bsgom/ /chos mchog mjug thogs de ma thag pa ru/ /'dod pa'i sdug bsngal la dmigs chos shes pa'i/

/bzod pa skye zhing de rjes de nyid la/ /dmigs pa'i sdug bsngal chos shes skye bar 'gyur/ /der rjes khams gong sdug bsngal la dmigs pa'i/ /rjes bzod rjes shes rim pa bzhin du ste/ /bden pa lhag ma rnams la'ang snga ma ltar/ /dmigs pa'i bzod shes bcu gnyis rim bzhin skye/ /de lta'i bzod pa brgyad ni mthong spang gi /thob pa gcod la bar chad med lam ste/ /shes brgyad spang bya dang bral thob pa dang / /lhan cig skyes phyir de las rnam grol lam/ /skad cig dang po bco lnga bden pa'i rigs/ /ma mthong mthong phyir mthong ba'i lam zhes bya/ /phyi ma mthong zin goms byed bsgom lam yin/ /de tshe 'phags lam yan lag brgyad bsgom mo/ /de nas bsgom spang gnyen po bsgom pa'i lam/ /gong 'og sa la zhi rags dmigs rnam can/ /'jig rten pa yi zag bcas bsgom lam dang / /bden pa la dmigs de yi rnam pa can/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i zag med bsgom pa'i lam/ /de tshe byang chub yan lag bdun bsgom mo/ /de nas rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /bsgom spang spangs pa las thob rnam grol lam/ /zad dang mi skye shes pa 'khor bcas ni/ /mi slob lam ste yan lag bcu ldan no/ /lam la 'jug pa'i gang zag rigs can gsum/ /dang po nyid nas rang rang lam 'jug dang / /nyan thos sngon song sangs rgyas gnyis kyang yod/ /nyan thos myur na tshe gsum dag gis 'grub/ /bse ru bskal brgya byang sems grangs med gsum/ /tshogs bsags srid pa mtha' mar gyur pa'i tshe/ /bsam gtan bzhi pa'i rab mtha' la brten te/ /stan gcig nyid la nges byed cha mthun nas/ /brtsams te so so'i byang chub bar skyed byed/ /nyan thos so skye dad dang chos rjes 'brangs/ /'phags pa skyes bu zung bzhi gang zag brgyad/ /yongs nyams 'chi bar sems dang rjes su bsrung / /gnas las mi bskyod rtogs pa'i skal ba can/ /mi g.yo'i chos can zhes bya dgra bcom drug

/shes pa kun rdzob chos rjes gzhan sems shes/ /sdug kun 'gog lam zad dang mi skye shes/ /so skye gcig gnyis mthong bsgom bdun nam brgyad/ /mi g.yo'i chos can bcu ldan sangs rgyas rnams/ /stobs dang mi 'jigs dran nyer thugs rje che/ /mnyam dang mi mnyam cha shas gsum gsum dang / /rgyu 'bras phan 'dogs phun tshogs thun mong yin/ /thun mong nyon mongs med dang smon gnas shes/ /so so yang dag rig bzhi mngon shes drug /mngon shes lnga dang bsam gzugs tshad med bzhi/ /rnam thar zil gnon brgyad brgyad zad par bcu/ /de dag thob byed snyoms 'jug ting nge 'dzin/ /yan lag dang ldan zhi lhag zung 'brel yin/ /bsam gtan snyoms 'jug ces bya der skyes dang / /yon tan rten du de la 'jug pa gnyis/ /dbye na bsam gtan bzhi dang gzugs med bzhi/ /gzugs med yon tan rnams kyi rten yin yang / /yon tan kun gyi rten gyur bsam gtan yin/ /de dag zag med lam gyi ye shes dang / /ldan dang mi ldan sgom pa po'i dbye bas/ /mya ngan 'das dang 'khor ba'i 'bras bur 'gyur/ /'di dag drod nas brtsams te mi g.yo ba'i/ /chos can bar la rim gyis khyad zhugs yod/ /de yis bsam gtan bzhi pa la brten te/ /yul dang 'dus byas mtshan nyid pho mo yi/ /mtshan ma dang bral bdag med stong pa nyid/ /lam yang mdor phyir smon pa med pa ste/ /ting 'dzin de thob mya ngan 'das zhes bya/ /myang 'das gsum ka rnam grol du 'dra yang / /shes bya'i gnas la sbyangs pa'i khyad par dang / /rjes thob bsod nams tshogs kyi bye brag gis/ /rigs can gsum gyi 'bras bu so sor 'gyur/ /ces tshigs su bcad pa'i sgo nas bye brag tu smra ba'i gzhung lugs mdor bstan nas/ gnyis pa de'i don rgyas par bshad pa la/ /shes bya'i gnas zag pa dang bcas pa/ zag pa med pa'o/ /dang po la rgyas par dbye ba dang / bsdus te bstan pa'o/ /dang po la rgyas par dbye ba'i tshul dang /

de bsdu ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po la/ ril po la bdag tu 'dzin pa'i gnyen por phung po lnga/ gzugs la bdag tu 'dzin pa'i gnyen por skye mched bcu gnyis/ gnyis ka la bdag tu 'dzin pa'i gnyen por khams bco brgyad gsungs pa bshad pa'o/ /dang po la phung po zhes pa ni rigs mthun du ma phyogs gcig tu spungs pa yin la dbye na/ byang chub sems 'grel las/ gzugs dang tshor ba 'du shes dang / /'du byed rnam shes phung po lnga/ /de ltar nyan thos rnams la gsungs/ /zhes pa ltar lnga'i dang po gzugs phung gi mtshan nyid ni gzhig cing gzhom du rung ba ste mig sogs dbang po lnga dang / gzugs sogs don lnga dang / rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs rnams so/ /de yang mdzod las/ gzugs ni dbang po lnga dang don/ /lnga dang rnam rig byed min nyid/ /ces so/ /dbang po lnga ni 'chad 'gyur gyi yul rnams 'dzin pa'i rnam shes kyi rten gzugs dwangs pa ste/ de dag rnams kyi rnam shes rten/ /gzugs dwangs pa ni mig sogs rnams/ /zhes dang / phung po lnga'i rab byed las/ mig gi dbang po gang zhe na/ mig gi rnam par shes pa'i rten gzugs dwangs pa'o/ /zhes te 'og ma rnams la yang de bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /don lnga las gzugs ni sngo ser sogs kha dog gi gzugs dang / ring thung sogs dbyibs kyi gzugs gnyis sam/ snga ma la kha dog mi 'dra ba bcu gnyis dang / phyi ma la dbyibs mi 'dra ba brgyad de nyi shu'o/ /sgra ni zin pa'i 'byung ba chen po'i rgyu las byung ba ste/ sems can gyi rgyud kyis bsdus pa lung du ston mi ston pa gnyis dang / ma zin pa'i 'byung ba chen po'i rgyu las byung ba ste/ ma bsdus pa lung du ston mi ston gnyis yin la/ de re re la yang yid du 'ong ba dang mi 'ong ba gnyis gnyis kyi dbye bas brgyad do/ /ro ni mngar skyur lan tshwa tsha/ /kha ba bska ba rnam pa drug /ces pa ltar ro/

/dri ni zhim pa dang / nga ba dang / de dag nyid shas chung ba dang / che ba ni mnyam pa dang mi mnyam pa ste bzhi'o/ /reg bya ni rgyu'i reg bya 'byung ba bzhi'i reg bya bzhi dang / 'bras bu'i reg bya 'jam rtsub lci yang grang bkres skom zhes pa ltar bdun te bcu gcig go /de dag kyang mdzod las/ gzugs rnam gnyis dang rnam nyi shu/ /sgra ni rnam pa brgyad yod de/ /ro ni rnam drug dri rnam bzhi/ /reg bya bcu gcig bdag nyid do/ /zhes so/ /rnam par rig byed ma yin pa ni gnas skabs kyi khyad par rang kun nas slong byed las gzhan du sems g.yengs pa'i tshe dang / sems med pa'i snyoms 'jug gnyis la gnas pa'i tshe na yang yod la/ ngo bo'i khyad par dge mi dge kho nar nges pa/ rgyun gyi khyad par gnas skabs de dag tu yang mi gtong bas rgyun rjes su 'brel zhing brtan pa yin la/ de tsam zhig de'i thob pa la yang yod pas rgyu'i khyad par 'byung ba chen po rnams rgyur byas pa gang yin pa ste/ /g.yengs dang sems med pa yi yang / /dge dang mi dge rjes 'brel gang / /'byung ba che rnams rgyur byas pa/ /de ni rnam rig byed min brjod/ /ces so/ /zhar la 'bras gzugs rnams 'byung ba'i rgyur gyur pa 'byung ba bzhi ni/ sra gsher dro g.yo'i mtshan nyid can gyi sa la sogs pa bzhi ste/ de dag gis 'bras gzugs rnams skyed par byed cing khyad par du sas 'dzin chus sdud mes smin rlung gis mi rul ba'am rgyas par byed pa yin te/ 'byung ba dag ni sa khams dang / /chu dang me dang rlung khams dang / /'dzin pa la sogs las su grub/ /sra gsher dro nyid g.yo rnams te/ /zhes so/ /dbang don bcu po de dag nyid skye mched bcu gnyis gsung ba na gzugs can gyi skye mched bcu dang / khams bco brgyad gsung ba na thogs bcas kyi khams bcu zhes bstan te/ dbang don de dag kho na la/ /skye mched bcu dang khams bcur 'dod/

/ces so/ /tshor ba ni yul gyi khyad par nyams su myong ba ste/ /ngo bo'i sgo nas bde sdug btang snyoms gsum dang / rten gyi sgo nas mig gi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba la sogs pa drug go /'du shes ni yul gyi bye brag ma 'dres par mtshan mar 'dzin pa'am 'du shes pa ste/ sngo ser sogs don dang / pho mo sogs tha snyad kyi khyad par la mtshan mar 'dzin pa'o/ /de yang / tshor ba myong pa'o/ /'du shes ni mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i bdag nyid do/ /zhes so/ /'du byed ni phung po gzhan bzhi las rdzas gzhan du gyur pa'i 'dus byas zhes bye smra'i lugs la yin yang / mdo sde pa la sogs pa mi ldan pa'i 'du byed rnams phung po gzhan bzhi las rdzas gzhan du mi 'dod pas yul mngon par 'du byed pas 'du byed du brjod dgos so/ /de la sems dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i 'du byed dang / mi ldan pa'i 'du byed gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sems byung bzhi bcu rtsa drug las tshor 'du gnyis ma gtogs pa'i lhag ma rnams te/ de yang bzhi bcu rtsa drug ni/ /tshor dang 'du shes sems pa dang / /'dun dang reg dang blo gros dran/ /yid la byed dang mos pa dang / /ting nge 'dzin sems thams cad pa'o/ /zhes sems kyi sa mang bcu dang / dad dang bag yod shin tu sbyangs/ /btang snyoms ngo tsha shes khrel yod/ /rtsa ba rnam gnyis mi 'tshe dang / /brtson 'grus rtag tu dge las byung / /zhes dge ba'i sa bcu dang / /rmongs dang bag med le lo dang / /ma dad pa dang rmugs dang rgod/ /nyon mongs can las rtag tu byung / zhes nyon mongs pa'i sa pa drug dang / mi dge la ni khrel med dang / /ngo tsha med pa'o zhes mi dge ba'i sa pa gnyis dang / khro ba dang / 'khon du 'dzin dang g.yo dang ni/ /phrag dog 'tshig 'chab ser sna dang / /rgyu dang rgyags dang rnam 'tshe ni/ /nyon mongs chung ngu'i sa pa rnams/ /zhes nyon mongs pa chung ngu'i sa pa bcu dang / de yi steng du dbyig bshes kyis/

/rtog dang dpyod dang 'gyod pa dang / /gnyid dang khong khro chags rnams dang / /nga rgyal the tshom zhes bya ba/ /brgyad ni nges pa min par bshad/ /ces ma nges pa brgyad bshad pa rnams so/ /gnyis pa ni/ mi ldan pa yi 'du byed rnams/ /thob dang ma thob skal mnyam dang / /'du shes med snyoms 'jug dag dang / /srog dang mtshan nyid rnams dang ni/ /ming gi tshogs la sogs pa yang / /zhes pa rnams te ngos 'dzin 'og tu 'chad do/ /de ltar tshor 'du 'du byed rnam par rig byed ma yin pa/ 'dus ma byas gsum dang bcas pa rnams skye mched bcu gnyis ston pa na chos kyi skye mched dang / khams bco brgyad ston pa na chos kyi khams zhes ming tha dad du brjod la rdzas ni de dag nyid yin no/ /de ltar yang / de gsum rnam rig byed min dang / /'dus ma byas dang bcas pa ni/ /chos kyi skye mched khams zhes bya/ /zhes so/ /rnam shes kyi phung po ni/ bdag rkyen mig sogs dbang po drug la brten nas gzugs sogs don gyi ngo bo so sor rnam par rig pa ste/ rnam shes so sor rnam rig pa/ /zhes so/ /so so'i sgra ni/ rnam shes drug po la yul gyi nges pa so sor yod pas smos pa'o/ /de yang mig la brten nas gzugs kyi don gyi ngo bo rig pa'i mig gi rnam par shes pa zhes pa nas/ yid la brten nas chos kyi don gyi ngo bo rig pa yid kyi rnam par shes pa zhes pa'i bar du shes par bya'o/ /rnam shes phung po de dag skye mched bcu gnyis 'chad pa na yid kyi skye mched dang / khams bco brgyad 'chad pa na rnam shes kyi khams drug dang yid kyi khams te bdun du'ang 'dod de/ yid kyi skye mched kyang de yin/ /khams bdun dag tu'ang 'dod pa ste/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa skye mched ni/ rnam shes drug gi nyer spyod skye ba'i sgo 'byed pa'i cha nas skye mched de/ de yang de drug gi nyer spyod gnas kyi sgo nas skye ba'i sgo 'byed pa'i phyir mig sogs dbang po drug nang gi skye mched dang /

de drug gi nyer spyod dmigs pa'i sgo nas skye ba'i sgo 'byed pa'i phyir gzugs sogs yul drug phyi'i skye mched du bzhag la/ mtshan gzhi ni gong du bshad zin to/ /gsum pa khams ni nyer spyod 'dzin pa ste/ de yang rnam shes drug gi nyer spyod gnas kyi sgo nas 'dzin pa la mig sogs dbang po'i khams drug dmigs pa'i sgo nas 'dzin pa la gzugs sogs yul gyi khams drug rang gi mtshan nyid kyi 'dzin pa la rnam par shes pa'i khams drug ste bco brgyad do/ /de la mig gi khams ni 'das pa dang da ltar gyi mig gi dbang po ni/ mig gi rnam par shes pa'i nyer spyod bzung zin pa dang 'dzin bzhin pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /theg chen pa rnams kun gzhi la yod pa'i mig gi sa bon dang / da ltar mig dbang gi rnam par snang ba'i kun gzhi'i rnam smin gyi cha ste de dag mig gi rgyu yin pas mig gi khams zhes bya'o zhes 'dod do/ /de bzhin du dbang don rnam shes lhag ma rnams la yang shes par bya'o/ /'o na rnam shes tshogs drug ni rnam shes kyi khams su bshad pa min nam/ de dag las gzhan pa'i yid kyi khams de gang zhe na/ de dag las gzhan pa'i yid kyi khams med kyi/ 'on kyang 'jug shes drug po gang rung 'das ma thag pa'i gnas skabs kyi rnam shes gang yin pa de nyid yid shes phyi ma'i rten byed pa'i phyir yid kyi khams yin no/ /de ltar na rnam shes khams drug yid kyi khams su bsdus pa'i phyir khams bco brgyad du mi 'gyur ro zhe na/ rnam shes dang po lnga mig sogs dbang po lnga la brten la/ yid shes la rten gzhan med pas drug pa yid kyi rnam shes kyi rten bsgrub pa'i phyir/ rnam shes khams drug la sogs su yid kyi khams rnam par bzhag pas khams bco brgyad du 'gyur ro/ /de ltar yang / rnam par shes pa drug dang yid/ /drug po 'das ma thag pa yi/ /rnam shes gang yin de yid do/

/drug pa'i rten ni rab bsgrub phyir/ /khams ni bco brgyad dag tu 'dod/ /ces so/ /'di dag 'og tu shes bya gzhi lnga'i skabs su bshad kyang rung mod/ ljon shing nyid kyi sa bcad 'debs tshul gyi dgongs pa bskang ba'i phyir dang / blo dman pa rnams la phan pa'i ched du 'dir bshad pa yin no/ /gnyis pa bsdu ba'i tshul la/ zag bcas zag med kyis bsdu ba dang / chos kyis bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la zag bcas ni/ lam bden ma gtogs pa'i 'dus byas rnams te/ de yang phung po lnga dang skye mched bcu gnyis dang / khams phyed dang bco brgyad de/ mdor na sdug kun gnyis kyis bsdus pa rnams zag pa dang bcas pa yin te/ de dag la zag pa dmigs pa dang mtshungs ldan gyi sgo nas rgyas par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /de yang / lam ma gtogs pa'i 'dus byas rnams/ /zag bcas gang phyir de dag la/ /zag rnams kun tu rgyas par 'gyur/ /zhes te/ 'dir rgyas pa'i don phan tshun 'phrod cing mthun par 'gyur ba yin no/ /zag med ni 'dus byas kyi nang nas lam bden dang / der ma zad chos kyi skye mched dang khams kyi phyogs gcig gis bsdus pa'i 'dus ma byas gsum yang yin te/ gang las zag pa rgyas par mi 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /de yang / zag med lam gyi bden pa dang / /'dus ma byas rnams gsum yang ste/ /zhes so/ /gong du lam ma gtogs pa'i zhes pas lam bden thogs med du rtogs nus kyang / 'jig rten pa'i lam yang zag med du dogs pa'i gnas yod pas 'dir lam gyi bden pa zhes bshad pa yin no/ /ljon shing gi dpe phal cher las/ chos kyi khams kyi phyogs gcig ces pa'i mthar dang zhes 'byung ba ni/ 'og gi drug ni zhes pas 'khrul gzhi byas nas mi mkhas pa dag gis bcos par snang bas mi dgos la/ de'i tshab tu ste zhes pa 'byung ba rnams dpe dag pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni nam mkha' dang 'gog pa gnyis ma gtogs pa'i chos rnams ni 'dus byas te/

rgyu rkyen gyis byas pa'i dngos po yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa ni byas pa'i dngos po ma yin pa'i phyir 'dus ma byas so/ /de yang zhal lung las/ nam mkha' dang ni 'gog pa gnyis/ /shin tu 'dus ma byas pa ste/ /shin tu brten byas 'dus byas kun/ /skad cig ma ste bdag po med/ /ces so/ /yang na bsdu bya shes bya'i gnas sum cu rtsa lnga po de dag sdud byed gzugs phung dang yid kyi skye mched dang tshos khams gsum gyis rang gi ngo bo yin pa nyid kyi sgo nas bsdus te/ de yang gzugs phung gis gzugs can gyi skye mched bcu dang khams bcu ste nyi shu bsdus/ yid kyi skye mched kyis sems kyi khams bdun dang rnam shes kyi phung po ste brgyad bsdus/ chos khams kyis tshor 'du 'du byed kyi phung po gsum dang / chos kyi skye mched de bzhi bsdus pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang / phung po dang ni skye mched dang / /khams gcig gis ni thams cad bsdus/ /zhes so/ /dbang po nyi shu rtsa gnyis ni/ sems kyi rten mig sogs dbang po drug bye brag 'byed byed pho dbang mo dbang gnyis/ gnas byed srog gi dbang po/ kun nas nyon mongs par byed pa tshor ba bde sdug yid bde yid mi bde btang snyoms te lnga/ rnam byang tshogs sog byed dad pa/ brtson 'grus/ dran pa/ ting nge 'dzin/ shes rab ste lnga/ rnam par byang bar byed pa la mi shes pa kun shes par byed pa kun shes pa/ kun shes ldan pa'i dbang po dang gsum ste nyer gnyis so/ /de yang / sems kyi rten dang de'i bye brag /gnas dang kun nas nyon mongs dang / /tshogs dang rnam byang ji snyed pa/ /dbang po dag kyang de snyed do/ /zhes so/ /rgyu drug ni/ byed rgyu lhan cig 'byung ba dang / /skal mnyam mtshungs par ldan pa dang / /kun du 'gro dang rnam smin te/ /rgyu ni rnam pa drug tu 'dod/ /ces so/ /'bras bu lnga ni/ rnam smin/ rgyu mthun/ bdag po/

skyes bu/ byed pa/ dri ma med pa'o/ /rkyen bzhi ni/ rgyu'i rkyen/ dmigs pa/ de ma thag pa/ bdag po'i rkyen te 'di dag zhib tu ma spros so/ /spyi don gnyis pa bsdus te bstan pa la/ snang ba gzugs kyi gzhi/ gtso bo sems kyi gzhi/ 'khor sems byung gi gzhi/ ldan pa ma yin pa 'du byed kyi gzhi/ 'dus ma byas rtag pa'i gzhi'o/ /dang po gzugs kyi gzhi ni sngar bshad pa'i gzugs kyi phung po ste/ de yang khams 'og ma gnyis kho na na yod do/ /de rdzas shin tu nyung ba la drug yod de/ dper na gzugs khams na dri ro gnyis med pas dbang po'i rdul dang sgra'i rdul gang yang med pa'i bsags pa'i gong bu phra rab gcig la sogs byed/ 'byung ba bzhi dang / gzugs dang reg bya'i rdul te rdzas drug dang ldan la/ de'i steng du sor mo'i rtse mo lta bu lus dbang dang ldan na rdzas bdun lhan cig tu skye zhing / mig sogs dbang po gzhan dang ldan pa la de nyid dang khyab byed sngar gyi bdun te rdzas brgyad lhan cig tu skye'o/ /'dod khams na dri ro gnyis kyang yod pas bsags rdul phra rab gcig la rdzas brgyad dang / lus dbang dang ldan pa la dgu dang / dbang po gzhan ldan la rdzas bcu lhan cig tu skye ste/ 'dod na dbang po med pa dang / /sgra med phra rab rdul rdzas brgyad/ /lus dbang ldan la rdzas dgu dang / /dbang po gzhan ldan rdzas bcu 'o/ /zhes so/ /de nyid sgra dang ldan par skye na rdzas bcu gcig dang ldan par skye'o/ /'dir rdzas kyi don yang 'byung ba bzhi ni rdzas kyi rigs la rdzas su bzung zhing / gzhan rnams skye mched kyi rigs la rdzas su bzung ba yin no/ /rdzas rnams mnyam por yod kyang 'ga' zhig gsal bar dmigs pa ni rdzas kyi nus pa'i bye brag las yin te/ dper na khab dang lhan cig pa'i shing los lus la brud pa na khab kyi reg bya gsal ba bzhin no zhes 'dod do/ /de ltar na gzugs kyi gzhi thams cad rdzas su yod pa kho na yin la/

de la rdul phran dang rags pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ cha shas med pa dbus rdul la phyogs drug gi rdul gyis bskor ba bar dang bcas pa ste/ phyi rol don grub las/ tha dad phyogs nas mang po dag /'ga' la kun nas bskor tsam du/ /brjod par zad kyi rdul de ni/ /cha shas bcas pa'i bdag nyid min/ /zhes te cha yod na cha shas gzhan dbyer rung bas rdul phran du mi rung ba'i phyir ro/ /des brtsam pa'i rags pa rnams ni g.yag rnga dang ne'u gseng ltar phyogs gcig tu 'dus nas bya ba gcig byed pas rdzas su grub par 'dod la/ rdul phran so sor mi 'gyes pa ni 'dzin par byed pa'i rlung gis bsdus pas so zhes zer ro/ /rdul phran de'ang dbang shes la snang ba la/ rtog pas rags pa nges par 'dod de/ de nyid las/ rnam par rtog pa'i shes pa yis/ /de gcig nyid du nges par byed/ /de phyir rang gi mtshan nyid kyi/ /rnam par shes pas rdul phran rnams/ /mi snang zhes ni smra ba gang / /de rnams thams cad sgrub ma yin/ /zhes so/ /sems kyi gzhi ni sngar bshad pa'i rnam shes kyi phung po ste rnam par shes pa'i tshogs drug go /de yang gzugs sogs gzung ba dang / mig shes sogs 'dzin pa rnams rdzas tha dad dus mnyam pa/ shes pa la don gyi rnam pa ma shar bar don nyid thug phrad du 'dzin par 'dod de ye shes snying po las/ dbang skyes blo ni rnam med kyis/ /phra rab bsags pa dngos su rig /ces so/ /gal te blo don tha dad dus mnyam la 'brel ba med pas gzung 'dzin du mi 'thad do zhe na/ dmigs rkyen dang shes pa dus mnyam pa'i rgyu 'bras su 'dod cing / rgyu tshogs gcig las skyes pas mtshe ma lta bu'i 'brel pa 'thad par 'dod do/ /rnam pa med na mig shes kyi sgra yang rig par thal lo snyam na ma yin te/ don de dag dbang po tha dad kyi yul yin pa'i phyir te/ phyi rol don grub las/ gzugs sgra la sogs don rnams ni/

/dbang po tha dad spyod yul lo/ /des na de dag gcig po yi/ /myong bar bya ba ma yin 'dir/ /zhes so/ /des na rten bcas kyi dbang po don la lta byed yin gyis/ shes pa kho na ma yin te/ mdzod las/ mig gi gzugs rnams mthong rten bcas/ /de la brten pa'i rnam shes min/ /gang phyir bar du chod pa yi/ /gzugs rnams mthong ba med phyir lo/ /zhes so/ /sems byung gi gzhi ni sngar bshad pa'i tshor 'du gnyis kyang gtogs pa'i sems byung lnga bcu rtsa gcig ste/ de yang mdzod rjes 'brang dang bcas pa las bzhi bcu rtsa drug tu gsungs pa ni/ gti mug med pa dang lta ba dang shes bzhin ma yin pa gsum shes rab kyi rdzas dang / rnam g.yengs ting nge 'dzin nyon mongs can yin pas ting nge 'dzin gyi rdzas dang / brjed ngas dran pa nyon mongs can yin pas dran pa'i rdzas su 'dus pa la bsam pa yin la/ ljon shing las/ sems byung lnga bcu rtsa gcig tu gsungs pa ni de lnga so sor phye ba la dgongs pa yin gyi/ kun las btus kyi grangs 'dren lugs ltar ni ma yin no/ /sems dang sems las byung ba gnyis ni lhan cig tu skye'o/ /de'ang dbang po gcig la brten pas rten mtshungs pa dang / yul gcig la dmigs pas dmigs pa mtshungs pa dang / sems sngon po'i rnam ldan yin na de'i 'khor gyi tshor ba sogs kyang sngon po'i rnam ldan yin pas rnam pa mtshungs pa dang / cig car du 'jug pa sogs dus mtshungs pa dang / rigs 'dra grangs mnyam pa ste gtso sems rdzas gcig yin pa na de'i 'khor gyi tshor ba'ang rdzas re bar gsungs pas so/ /de yang mtshungs par ldan pa rnam pa lnga/ /zhes so/ /sems byung rnams kyang rnam med rdzas grub tu 'dod la/ sems dang sems byung gnyis ka'ang gzhan rig 'ba' zhig tu 'dod kyi/ rang rig mi 'dod kyi/ ka ma la shī las/ bye brag tu smra ba la sogs pa ni rang rig pa'i mngon sum yang rigs pa ma yin te/

bdag nyid la byed pa 'gal ba'i phyir ro zhes so/ /ldan pa ma yin pa 'du byed kyi gzhi ni sngar bshad pa'i thob pa la sogs pa bcu bzhi ste/ thob pa ni sngar ma rnyed pa rnyed pa dang / rnyed kyang nyams pa las slar rnyed pa dang / de dag gi rgyun ldan pa'o/ /ma thob pa ni de las ldog pa'o/ /skal mnyam ni sems can rnams 'dra bar byed pa'i rdzas khams dang 'gro ba dang skye gnas la sogs pa rigs mthun pa'o/ /'du shes med pa ni 'du shes med pa'i lha dag gi nang du skyes pa na sngon 'du shes med pa'i snyoms 'jug bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis sems dang sems byung rang gi ngang gis 'gags pa'o/ /'du shes med pa'i snyoms 'jug ni/ bsam gtan bzhi pa la brten te tshogs drug bkag pa la thar pa lam du 'du shes pas sems sems byung rnams bkag pa'i snyoms 'jug go /'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug ni/ srid rtse la brten nas 'du shes dang tshor ba la skye ste/ 'gog snyoms la zhi ba myang 'das dang 'dra bar 'du shes pas sems sems byung rnams bkag pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa'o/ /srog ni khams gsum pa'i tshe ste drod dang rnam shes kyi rten no/ /'dus byas kyi mtshan nyid bzhi las skye ba ni 'dus byas skyed par byed pa'o/ /gnas pa ni skyes pa de nyid skad cig gnas pa'o/ /rga ba ni 'dus byas rnying par byed pa'o/ /mi rtag pa ni 'dus byas 'jig pa'o/ /ming gi tshogs ni/ gzugs zhes pa lta bu don de'i brdar byas pa'o/ /tshig ni 'dus byas mi rtag ces pa lta bu don gyi khyad par tsam ston pa'i ngag go /yi ge ni a la sogs pa ming tshig gi gzhir 'gyur pa'o/ /'di rnams kyang gzugs sems sems byung las tha dad pa rdzas su yod pa kho na yin no zhes 'dod do/ /'dus ma byas kyi gzhi ni nam mkha' ni bsgrib bya sgrib byed dang bral zhing gzugs can gyi go 'byed pa'o/ /so sor brtags 'gog ni/ bden pa bzhi la bar chad med lam gyi shes rab kyis so sor brtags pas thob pa'i 'gog pa gang /

zag pa dang bcas pa'i chos dang bral ba'o/ /so sor brtags min gyi 'gog pa ni rkyen ma tshang bas ma 'ongs pa'i chos zag bcas zag med rnams skye ba la gtan du gegs byed pa'i 'gog pa ste snga ma las gzhan du gyur pa'o/ /'di dag kyang rtag pa'i rdzas su yod pa kho na'o/ /yul dbus kyi bye brag tu smra ba rnams de bzhin nyid dang bzhi yin zer ro// //spyi don gnyis pa zag bcas bye brag tu bshad pa la/ 'bras bu sdug bsngal gyi bden pa dang / rgyu kun 'byung gi bden pa'o/ /dang po ni/ kun 'byung gi 'bras bur gyur pa'i zag bcas te/ de la yang gang du kun nas nyon mongs pa dang / gang kun nas nyon mongs pa'o/ /dang po ni/ khams gsum dang sa dgus bsdus pa'i snod kyi 'jig rten no/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'dod pa'i khams na ngan song gi 'gro ba sa gsum/ gling bzhi'i mi/ 'dod lha rigs drug dang / gzugs khams na gnas rigs bcu bdun dang / gzugs med na skye mched mu bzhi ste mdor na 'dod khams sa gcig gzugs khams bsam gtan bzhi/ gzugs med skye mched mu bzhi ste sa dgu'o/ /'di dag gi sdug bsngal gyi rnam grangs ni 'og tu 'chad do/ /gnyis pa kun 'byung gi bden pa ni sdug bsngal bden pa'i rgyur gyur pa ste/ dbye na las kyi kun 'byung dang / nyon mongs pa'i kun 'byung gnyis las/ dang po las kyi kun 'byung la sems pa dang bsam pa'i las ni/ mdzod las/ las las 'jig rten sna tshogs skyes/ /de ni sems pa dang des byas/ /sems pa yid kyi las yin no/ /des bskyed lus dang ngag gi las/ /zhes pa ltar yid dang lus ngag gi las so/ /'di la rig byed kyi las dang / rig byed ma yin pa'i las gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sems pa'i dbang gis bstod phyag byed pa la sogs pa phyi lus ngag gi rnam 'gyur gyis nang gi kun slong rig par byed pas na rnam par rig byed kyi las so/ /gnyis pa la sdom pa sdom min bar ma gsum las/

dang po la so thar bsam gtan zag med kyi sdom pa gsum gyi dang po ni/ chos 'di pa dag gis 'dod pa na spyod pa'i tshul khrims te so thar rigs brgyad kyis bsdus pa'i bslab pa rnams so/ /gnyis pa ni gzugs na spyod pa'i tshul khrims te lus ngag gi spong ba bdun no/ /gsum pa ni/ zag pa med pa'i spong ba bdun no/ /sdom min ni/ sdom min can gyi rigs su skyes nas de'i las byed pa'am/ ji srid 'tsho bar du sdig pa'i las khas blangs pa las skyes pa'i lus ngag gi las te/ mdzod las/ sdom pa min pa bya ba'am/ /khas len pa las skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /bar ma'i rig byed ma yin pa ni sdom pa sdom min gnyis ka ma yin pa'i dge mi dge'i las nang gi kun slong rig par mi byed pa rnams so/ /sdom min can dang ba'i shugs kyis mchod rten la phyag byed pa dang / sdom pa can nyon mongs pa'i shugs kyis gsod sogs la 'jug pa'i tshe bar ma skye bar 'dod do/ /gzhan yang mdo las 'byung ba'i las kyi rnam grangs ni/ rnam smin yid du 'ong ba 'byin pa dang / yid du mi 'ong ba 'byin pa dang / de gnyis ka lung du mi ston pa dge mi dge lung ma bstan gyi las gsum dang / yang 'dod khams kyi dge ba dang mi dge ba la bsod nams dang bsod nams ma yin pa'i las dang / khams gang gi las dge ba la mi g.yo ba'i las zhes bya ba gsum dang / yang 'dod khams nas bsam gtan gsum pa'i bar gyi las dge ba la bde ba myong 'gyur dang / de dag gi las mi dge ba la sdug bsngal myong 'gyur dang / bsam gtan bzhi pa dang gzugs med kyi las dge ba la btang snyoms myong 'gyur zhes bya la/ de dag myong bar nges ma nges kyi bye brag gis gnyis dang / myong ba nges pa'ang tshe 'di dang / phyi ma dang / tshe rabs gzhan la myong 'gyur gsum dang / ma nges pa ste bzhir yang yod do/ /gzhan yang ngo bo nyon mongs can rnam smin yid du mi 'ong ba 'byin pa'i phyir las gnag rnam smin gnag pa dang /

ngo bo mi dge ba dang ma 'dres shing rnam smin yid du 'ong ba 'byin pa gnyis ka dkar ba dang / ngo bo 'dres pa ma yin kyang de ldan gyi rgyud la 'dres par 'jug la rnam smin yang 'dres mar myong ba las dkar gnag la rnam smin dkar gnag dang / ngo bo nyon mongs can ma yin zhing / rnam smin dkar ba med pa/ mi dkar mi nag gi las te bzhir yang bshad do/ /gnyis pa la rtsa ba'i nyon mongs pa dang / nye ba'i nyon mongs pa dang gnyis las/ dang po'i ngo bo ni/ gnas ma bu nyon mongs pa'i thob pa la dang / bye brag smra ba kun dkris mngon gyur dang / mdo sde pa bag la nyal te/ nyon mongs pa'i sa bon la phra rgyas su 'dod do/ /de la dbye na srid pa'i rtsa ba phra rgyas drug /'dod chags de bzhin khong khro dang / /nga rgyal ma rig lta ba dang / /the tshom yin te de drug kyang / /'dod chags dbye bas bdun du bshad/ /ces dang / khams gnyis las skyes srid 'dod chags/ /zhes gsungs pas/ 'dod chags la 'dod pa'i 'dod chags dang / srid pa'i 'dod chags gnyis kyi dbye bas bdun du 'gyur ro/ /lta ba la dbye na/ lta ba lnga ste 'jig tshogs dang / /log dang mthar 'dzin lta ba dang / /lta ba dang ni tshul khrims dang / /brtul zhugs mchog tu 'dzin dang bcu/ /zhes te/ go rim bzhin du nyer len gyi phung po lnga la bdag dang bdag gir lta ba lnga dang / bden pa sogs med pa dang / rtag chad dang / lta sogs zag bcas kun la mchog tu dang / byang grol mtho ris kyi lam la lam du dang / de dag gi rgyu min la rgyur lta'o/ /nga rgyal ni sems khengs pa ste/ dbye na/ chung bas bdag mchog la mnyam pa dang mnyam mo snyam du sems khengs pa nga rgyal dang / mnyam po bas lhag go snyam du sems khengs pa lhag pa'i dang / mchog pas dang bdag lhag go snyam pa nga rgyal las kyang nga rgyal dang / nyer len gyi phung po la bdag gir khengs pa nga'o snyam pa'i dang / bsam gzugs la brten pa'i zag bcas zag med kyi chos mngon du ma byas pa la bdag gis byas so snyam pa mngon pa'i dang /

ches khyad par du 'phags pa las bdag cung zad cig gis dman snyam pa'i sems khengs pa cung zad snyam pa'i dang / yon tan med pa la yon tan dang ldan no snyam pa'i log pa'i nga rgyal lo/ /gnyis pa nye ba'i nyon mongs pa ni sum cu par/ khro ba 'khon du 'dzin pa dang / /'chab dang 'tshig dang phrag dog dang / /ser sna dang ni rgyur bcas dang / /g.yo rgyags rnam 'tshe ngo tsha med/ /khrel med rmugs dang rgod pa dang / /ma dad pa dang le lo dang / /bag med pa dang brjed ngas dang / /rnam g.yengs shes bzhin ma yin pa/ /zhes pa rnams so// //spyi don gsum pa zag med bye brag tu bshad pa la/ bden pa'i dbye ba bstan pa/ de'i mngon par rtogs pa skye tshul/ de'i gang zag gi dbye ba/ gang zag gi shes pa'i dbye ba/ ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par bstan pa'o/ /dang po la bden pa bzhir dbye ba dang gnyis su dbye ba'o/ /dang po la sdug kun 'gog pa lam bzhi las/ dang po la mtshan gzhi dang mtshan nyid gnyis kyi dang po ni/ sdug bsngal gsum mam brgyad kyis gdung ba dang bcas pas na sdug bsngal te/ de la sdug bsngal gsum ni sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal dang / 'gyur ba'i dang / 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal lo/ /sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal ni tshor ba sdug bsngal gnas dang bcas pa thams cad de/ rang gi mtshan nyid kyis sdug bsngal ba'i phyir ro/ /'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal ni/ zag bcas kyi tshor ba bde ba gnas dang bcas pa ste/ nyams na gdung ba bskyed pa'i phyir ro/ /'du byed kyi sdug bsngal ni/ zag bcas kyi tshor ba btang snyoms gnas dang bcas pa ste/ sdug bsngal gzhan gnyis kyi sa bon dang ldan pas btang snyoms khor mo yug tu mi gnas pa'i phyir dang / gcig tu 'grub pa dang bde ba ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /des na snod bcud thams cad zag bcas yin pas 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal yin no/ /brgyad ni/ phrad bral gyur dang re ba med/ /skye rga na dang 'chi ba 'o/

/zhes te/ de dag kyang rim pa ltar dgra la sogs pa yul yid du mi 'ong ba dang 'phrad pa dang / bu sdug pa la sogs pa yid du 'ong ba dang bral ba dang / phyug po dbul por song ba sogs sngar bshad pa'i 'gyur ba dang / 'dod pa'i dngos po btsal yang ma rnyed pa re ba 'bras bu med pa dang / mngal dog pa la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal 'byung ba skye ba dang / na tshod 'gyur bas sdug bsngal ba rga ba dang / khams ma snyoms pas sdug bsngal ba na ba dang / srog 'gyur bas sdug bsngal ba 'chi ba ste mdor na nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga gnas ngan len gyis sdug bsngal ba'i phyir sdug bsngal yin no/ /gnyis pa mtshan nyid ni/ sdug bden la byis pa rnams phyin ci log bzhir zhen pa'i phyir/ de'i gnyen por mtshan nyid bzhi ste/ rtag 'dzin gyi gnyen por mi rtag pa dang / bde ba dang gtsang bar 'dzin pa'i gnyen por sdug bsngal ba dang / gnyis pa mtshan nyid ni/ sdug bden la byis pa rnams phyin ci log bzhir zhen pa'i phyir/ de'i gnyen por mtshan nyid bzhi ste/ rtag 'dzin gyi gnyen por mi rtag pa dang / bde ba dang gtsang bar 'dzin pa'i gnyen por sdug bsngal ba dang / bdag 'dzin la gnyis kyi phung po'i ngo bo la bdag tu 'dzin pa'i gnyen por bdag med dang / don gzhan la bdag tu 'dzin pa'i gnyen por stong pa'o/ /de yang skad cig gis mi sdod cing rgyun gyis 'gyur ba'i phyir mi rtag lus sems yongs su gdung ba'i phyir sdug bsngal/ dpyad na phung po las don gzhan pa'i byed pa po dang za ba po'i bdag med pa'i phyir stong pa/ mi rtag pa dang du ma'i phyir phung po rnams rtag pa gcig pu'i bdag med pa ste bzhi dang ldan no/ /gnyis pa kun 'byung la gnyis las/ mtshan gzhi ni 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi rgyu zag bcas kyi las dang / nyon mongs pa gnyis so/ /dang po las la dge sdig gnyis las/ dge ba ni ma chags zhe sdang gti mug med pa ste/

rtsa ba gsum gyis bskyed pa'i sgo gsum gyi las te/ rnam smin yid du 'ong ba 'byin byed yin pa'i phyir ro/ /spyir dge ba la/ ngo bo nyid dang / 'brel pa dang / kun nas slong ba'i dge ba'o/ /dang po ni/ sems byung gi nang tshan dad sogs rnams te/ sman bzang po ltar rang bzhin gyis rnam par dkar ba'i ngo bor skyes pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ de dag dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems sems byung rnams te/ sman dang sbyar ba'i btung ba ltar grogs stobs kyis dge bar skyes pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa ni/ snga ma de dag gis kun nas bslangs pa'i lus ngag gi las te/ sman gyi btung ba'i spris ma ltar rgyu'i stobs kyis dge bar skyes pa'i phyir ro/ /mi dge ba ni/ dug gsum gyis kun nas bslangs pa'i sgo gsum gyi las te/ rnam smin yid du mi 'ong ba 'byin byed yin pas so/ /de la'ang snga ma ltar gsum las/ ngo bo nyid kyi mi dge ba ni lus ngag gi nyes spyod kun nas bslangs pa'i nyon mongs pa dang / nye ba'i nyon mongs pa rnams so/ /'brel pa ni de dag dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems sems byung rnams so/ /slong ba'i ni de dag gis kun nas bslangs pa'i lus ngag gi las rnams so/ /'di dag cung zad bshad zin la/ rgyas par gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /nyon mongs pa'i kun 'byung la spyir bshad pa dang / so sor bshad pa'o/ /dang po spyir bshad pa la rtsa ba'i dbye ba bza' bya bde sdug btang snyoms gsum la log par zhugs pa go rim bzhin du/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum yin la/ za ba po sems can la log par zhugs pa nga rgyal dang / phyin ci ma log par nges pa la log par sgrub pa lta ba dang the tshom ste drug yin no/ /drug po de dag las lta ba la lngar phye bas bcur 'gyur ro/ /'o na nga rgyal la yang bdun du 'byed par rigs so zhe na mi mtshungs te/ lta ba dag ni nyes dmigs che ba'i phyir/

lngar phye ste 'bad de spang bar bya ba'i phyir du yin pas so/ /'di dag nye nyon dang bcas pa gong du'ang cung zad bshad zin to// //gnyis pa so sor bshad pa la bye smra'i lugs dang thun mong du grags pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'dod khams na sdug bsngal mthong bas spang bar bya ba bcu/ kun 'byung dang 'gog pa la lta ba dang po gnyis dang lnga pa ma gtogs bdun bdun/ lam la lta ba dang po gnyis ma gtogs brgyad de sum cu rtsa gnyis/ bden pa mthong ba tsam gyis kyang spang ma nus pa'i 'dod khro nga rgyal ma rig pa ste bzhi'i rigs kha cig ni bsgom spang ste sum cu rtsa drug khams gong ma gnyis rgyud zhi gnas dang ldan pa'i phyir nyon mongs rtsub bag tsam khong khro med pas de gnyis na mthong spang dgu dang drug drug bdun te nyer brgyad/ 'dod chags nga rgyal ma rig pa gsum bsgom spang yang yin pas sum cu rtsa gcig re ste/ khams gsum na mthong bsgom gyi spang bya dgu bcu rtsa brgyad yod do/ /de yang / de dag bcu dang bdun bdun brgyad/ /lta ba gsum gnyis ma gtogs pa/ /'dod na sdug bsngal la sogs pa/ /mthong bas rim bzhin spong bar byed/ /bzhi ni bsgom pas spang bya yin/ /khong khro ma gtogs de dag nyid/ /gzugs khams gzugs med de dang 'dra/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa la/ mthong spang / bsgom spang / thun mong du ngo bo ngos gzung ba'o/ /dang po ni/ 'dod khams na bden pa bzhi po rang rang gi chos nyid mthong ba tsam gyis spang bar bya ba'i nyon mongs pa bcu phrag bzhi ste/ sdug bsngal mthong bas spang bar bya ba'i nyon mongs pa bcu/ de bzhin du gzhan gsum la'ang bcu bcu ste bzhi bcu'o/ /khams gong ma gnyis na khong khro med pas dgu dgu ste sum cu rtsa drug thams cad bsdoms na khams gsum na mthong spang gi nyon mongs pa brgya rtsa bcu gnyis yod do/ /de la 'jig lta dang mthar lta kun brtags kyi cha dang / lta ba gzhan gsum dang /

the tshom dang / lta ba de dag la log zhugs kyi 'dod chags khong khro nga rgyal ma rig pa rnams mthong spang yin no/ /gnyis pa bsgom spang ni/ yul la log par zhugs pa'i 'dod chags sogs bzhi dang / lhan skyes kyi 'jig lta dang mthar lta ste/ 'dod pa na bsgom spang drug khams gong gnyis na khong khro ma gtogs pa lnga lnga ste khams gsum na bsgom spang gi nyon mongs bcu drug yod do/ /gsum pa thun mong du ngo bo ngos gzung ba ni/ de la mthong spang rnams ni thos bsam log par byas pa sogs las 'byung bas kun brtags zhes bya ste/ mu stegs byed kyis bdag dang gtso bo sogs su sgro btags pa lta bu'o/ /bsgom spang ni thog ma med pa nas goms pa'i dbang gis sems can thams cad la rjes su zhugs pas lhan cig skyes pa zhes bya ste/ dud 'gro yan chad la phung po la nga'o snyam pa'i blo rjes su 'brel pa lta bu'o/ /des na de gnyis la spang dka' sla'i khyad par yod do/ /gnyis pa mtshan nyid ni las nyon gyi kun 'byung de dag srid pa'i bag chags 'jog byed yin pas rgyu/ sdug bsngal rdzas rigs sna tshogs 'byung bar byed pas kun 'byung / sems can gyi yul dus rnam pa tha dad bskyed pa'i phyir rab skye/ lus blangs zin 'dor ba dang / ma blangs pa len par byed pas rkyen zhes bya ba bzhi dang ldan no/ /gsum pa 'gog bden la yang gnyis las/ mtshan gzhi'i ngo bo ni/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bsgom byung gi shes rab kyis mthong bsgom gyi spang bya'i nyon mongs pa spangs pa'i so sor brtags 'gog dang / dbyings rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa spang bya glo bur gyi dri ma dang bral ba yang 'gog bden no/ /bzhi pa lam bden la gnyis kyi mtshan gzhi la mthong lam dang / bsgom lam zag med dang mi slob lam ni lam bden dngos yin la/ tshogs sbyor gnyis smos pa ni 'khor dang bcas pa'i dbang du byas pa yin pas de dang zag bcas bsgom lam ni zag bcas yin pas lam bden ma yin no/

/'on kyang rnam dbye shes pa'i ched du cung zad bshad na/ rgyud smin par byed pa gnyen po tshogs kyi lam/ nye bar spang ba'i gnyen po sbyor lam/ phyogs gcig spang ba'i gnyen po mthong lam/ mtha' dag spang ba'i gnyen po bsgom lam/ spang bya yongs su rdzogs pa mi slob lam ste lnga yin la/ nyon mongs zad pa la zad par shes pa dang / sdug bsngal mi skye ba la mi skye bar shes pa gnyis kyang mi slob lam gyi khyad par yin no/ /gnyis pa mtshan nyid ni/ thar pa'i grong du rim gyis bgrod pa'i phyir lam/ nyon mongs spang ba'i gnyen po yin pa'i phyir rigs pa/ sems phyin ci ma log par sgrub pas sgrub pa/ srid pa las gtan du grol zhing rtag pa'i gnas su nges par 'byin par byed pa'i phyir nges 'byin te mtshan nyid bzhi'o/ /gnyis pa bden pa gnyis su dbye ba ni/ tho ba la sogs pa 'joms byed kyis bcom pa dang / gzugs dang dri ro la sogs pa yan lag gi chos blos so sor phye na/ de dang de'i blo mi 'jug pa de ni kun rdzob yin te/ dper na tho bas bcom na de'i blo mi 'jug pa bum pa lta bu dang / yan lag gi chos rnams so sor phye zhing bsal na de'i blo mi 'jug pa chu la sogs pa bzhin te/ tha snyad du bum pa yod do chu yod do zhes brjod na bden pa kho nar 'gyur gyi/ brdzun par mi 'gyur ba bzhin no/ /bcom pa dang yan lag so sor dbye bar mi nus shing rang dbang du skyed par byed pa ni don dam par yod pa yin te/ cha med kyi shes pa dang / rdul phran dang / nam mkha' la sogs pa bzhin no/ /de yang gang la bcom dang blo yis gzhan/ /bsal na de blo mi 'jug pa/ /bum chu bzhin du kun rdzob tu/ /yod de don dam yod gzhan no/ /zhes so/ /spyi don gnyis pa de'i mngon par rtogs pa skye tshul la/ lam spyi'i sngon 'gro dang / so so'i skye tshul dngos so/ /dang po ni/ so sor thar pa rigs bdun gang rung gi tshul khrims la gnas nas sgo gsum nyes pa mtha' dag las bzlog par bya zhing /

de'i 'og tu bden pa mngon par rtogs pa dang rjes su mthun pa'i gsung rab nyan pa'i sgo nas thos pa bya/ thos pa'i don rig pas rnam par dpyad de tshul bzhin du sems pa'i bsam byung gi shes rab mngon du byed/ de dang ldan pa'i sgo nas bsam pa'i don rtse gcig tu yid la byed pa'i bsgom pa la sbyor ba'i tshul gyis lhag mthong gi rgyu zhi gnas bsgrub ste/ de yang / 'dod chags dang rnam rtog shas che ba'i gang zag gis mi sdug pa dang dbugs dbyung rngub dran pa ste/ de la 'jug pa mi sdug dang / /dbugs 'byung rngub pa dran pa yis/ /'dod chags rnam rtog lhags rnams la/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa lhag mthong bskyed pa la lam lnga la 'jug pa'i dang po dran pa nyer gzhag bzhi'i tshogs kyi lam ni/ zhi gnas grub par gyur pa yis/ /dran pa nyer gzhag bsgom par bya/ /zhes te/ lus tshor sems dang chos rnams la/ /mtshan nyid gnyis su yongs brtags pas/ /zhes pa ltar rang gi mtshan nyid gzhig cing gzhom du rung ba sogs dang / spyi'i mtshan nyid mi rtag sdug bsngal la sogs gnyis su brtags pas so/ /de la yang thos sogs las byung ba rang bzhin dang de'i grogs mtshungs ldan gzhan ni 'brel pa dang / yul rnams ni dmigs pa'i dran pa nyer gzhag ste/ shes rab thos sogs las byung ba/ /gzhan ni 'brel dang dmigs pa las/ /zhes so/ /de ltar na/ lus dang tshor ba sems dang chos/ /dran pa nyer gzhag shes rab bsgom/ /zhes te/ shes rab kyi rang spyi'i mtshan nyid la bltas nas dran pas dmigs pa de nyid la yang yang du gtod par byed pas dran pa nyer gzhag go /gnyis pa sbyor lam la dro ba ni chos dran pa nyer gzhag goms pas bden pa bcu drug po rnams la zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi snang ba cung zad skyes pas brtson 'grus khyad par can thob nas 'phags lam gyi snga ltas su gyur pa'i dge rtsa dro bar gyur pa skye ste/ de ni dmigs pa bden bzhi'i spyod yul can la rnam pa mi rtag la sogs bcu drug dang ldan pa yin no/

/de'i tshe/ sdig pa skyes spangs slar mi skyed/ /dge ba skyes spel ma skyes bskyed/ /yang dag spang ba brtson 'grus yin/ /zhes pa bzhi bsgom mo/ /de thob pa las kyang nges par myang 'das thob pa'i chos can yin no/ /rtse mo ni drod gsum rim gyis bsgoms pas sngar gyi bden pa la dmigs pa'i zung 'brel de rim gyis 'phel ba las dge rtsa g.yo ba rnams kyi rtse mor gyur pa ste dmigs rnam ni sngar bzhin no/ /de'i tshe/ dge la 'dun pa dge la brtson/ /dge la sems pa dge la spyod/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang pa ting 'dzin yin/ /zhes pa bzhi bsgom mo/ /de thob nas mtshams med byed srid kyang dge rtsa mi 'chad do/ /de las dro bar gyur pa 'byung / /de ni bden bzhi'i spyod yul can/ /rnam pa bcu drug dro ba las/ /rtse mo de yang de dang 'dra/ /zhes dang / rtse mo thob pa rtsa mi 'chad/ /ces so/ /rtse mo gsum rim gyis 'phel ba las/ bden pa rnams kyi chos nyid cha shas thong ba la bzod pa'i bzod pa skye ste/ de'i chung 'bring gnyis kyi rnam pa snga ma dang 'dra ste/ chos dran pa nyer gzhag gi dmigs pa'i bden pa rnams la rnam pa gtod pa'i phyir ro/ /chen po ni 'dod pa'i sdug bsngal kho na la dmigs shing skad cig ma gcig yin te/ de yang / de las bzod pa yang skye ste/ /rnam gnyis de bzhin zhes pa dang / /chen po sdug bsngal 'dod gtogs yul/ /zhes dang / de ni skad cig gcig ces so/ /de'i tshe/ dad dang brtson 'grus dran pa dang / /ting 'dzin shes rab dbang po lnga/ /zhes pa rnams bsgom mo/ /de thob pa las nyams kyang ngan song du mi 'gro ste/ der 'gro ba'i las nyon thag bsrings pa'i phyir te/ bzod thob ngan song yongs mi 'gro/ /zhes so/ /de'i 'og tu rgyu gzhan med par ting nge 'dzin des de ma thag tu rang gi rtsal gyis 'phags lam 'dren par byed pas 'jig rten pa'i chos rnams kyi mchog tu gyur pa'i chos mchog skye'o/

/dmigs rnam ni bzod chen dang 'dra ste/ de bzhin chos mchog ces so/ /de'i tshe/ dad brtson dran pa ting 'dzin dang / /shes rab stobs su gyur pa lnga/ /zhes pa rnams bsgom mo/ /de bzhi la nges 'byed cha mthun zhes bya ste/ sdug bsngal la sogs pa'i bden pa rnams la the tshom zhing / 'di ni sdug bsngal lo zhes sogs su nges par 'byed pa'i 'phags lam gyi cha mthong lam gyi phyogs gcig sdug bsngal la chos shes pa'i bzod pa 'dren par byed pas so/ /gsum pa mthong lam ni/ chos mchog gi mjug thogs su 'dod pa'i sdug bsngal la dmigs pa'i chos shes pa'i bzod pa skye la/ de'i mjug tu de nyid la dmigs pa'i sdug bsngal la chos shes pa skye zhing / de'i rjes su khams gong gi sdug bsngal la rjes su shes pa'i bzod pa dang / rjes su shes pa gnyis skye'o/ /bden pa lhag ma rnams la'ang snga ma ltar dmigs pa'i shes bzod bcu gnyis skye zhing / de yang 'dod pa'i kun 'byung la dmigs pa'i chos bzod chos shes gnyis dang / de nas khams gong gi kun 'byung la dmigs pa'i rjes bzod rjes shes gnyis skye/ de nas 'dod pa'i sdug bsngal 'gog pa la gnyis dang / de bzhin du khams gong ma'i sdug bsngal 'gog pa la gnyis dang / 'dod pa'i sdug bsngal gyi gnyen po lam la dmigs pa'i gnyis dang / khams gong gi sdug bsngal gyi gnyen po lam la dmigs pa'i gnyis te bcu drug go /sems kyi skad cig bcu drug po de'i bzod pa rnams ni mthong spang gi nyon mongs rnams kyi thob pa gcod pa la gzhan gyis bar chad bya bar mi nus pas bar chad med lam dang / shes pa rnams ni nyon mongs pa rnams dang bral ba'i thob pa dang lhan cig skyes pa'i phyir nyon mongs las rnam par grol ba'i lam mo/ /de yang / 'jig rten pa yis chos mchog las/ /chos kyi bzod pa zag pa med/ /'dod sdug bsngal la de nas ni/ /de nyid chos shes de bzhin yang /

/sdug bsngal lhag la rjes bzod shes/ /bden pa gsum la de bzhin no/ /zhes so/ /de dag kyang skad cig ma bco lnga ni bden pa'i rigs sngar ma mthong ba mthong bas mthong lam dang / bcu drug pa la bden pa'i rigs sngar ma mthong ba med cing mthong zin goms par byed pa'i phyir bsgom lam ste/ de ni chos mchog dang sa gcig /bzod dang shes pa go rim bzhin/ /bar chad med dang rnam grol lam/ /de las skad cig bco lnga ni/ /ma mthong mthong phyir mthong ba'i lam/ /zhes so/ /de'i tshe/ yang dag lta ba rtog pa dag /las mtha' 'tsho ba rtsol ba dang / /dran pa ting 'dzin 'phags lam brgyad/ /ces pa rnams bsgom bye smra'i lugs so/ /ljon shing gi dpe rnams las shes bzod phyi ma gnyis kun las btus dang mthun par 'byung ba ni/ skabs der phreng chad cung zad byung ba la gzhan zhig gis kun las btus dang mthun par bsabs pa yin gyis/ rtsom pa po'i bzhed pa ni mdzod ltar du yin par 'og gi shes pa ldan tshul gyi skabs la dpyad pas shes so zhes bla ma dag gsungs so/ /bzhi pa bsgom lam ni lam lnga'i bye brag gang zhig bsgom spang gi dngos kyi gnyen por gyur pa'o/ /de la sa 'og ma dang gong ma la dmigs nas rags sogs dang zhi sogs kyi rnam pa can 'jig rten pa'i bsgom lam zag bcas dang / zag med 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bsgom lam gnyis so/ /de yang / bsgom pa'i lam ni rnam gnyis te/ /zhes so/ /de'i tshe/ dran dang chos rab rnam 'byed dang / /brtson 'grus dga' dang shin tu sbyangs/ /ting 'dzin btang snyoms byang chub kyi/ /yan lag rnam pa bdun yin no/ /zhes pa rnams bsgom mo/ /lnga pa mi slob pa'i lam ni/ rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mjug thogs su byung ba'i rnam grol gyi lam zad mi skye shes 'khor bcas te/ mi slob pa'i yan lag bcu ldan no/ /yan lag bcu ni mi slob pa'i yang dag pa'i lta ba nas ting nge 'dzin gyi bar brgyad dang /

mi slob pa'i yang dag pa'i rnam grol te mos pa dang / mi slob pa'i yang dag pa'i shes pa ste bcu'o// //spyi don gsum pa de'i gang zag gi dbye ba la/ nyan rang sangs rgyas rigs can no/ /dang po ni/ spyir rigs can gsum po dang po nyid nas lam so so nyid la 'jug pa'ang yod la/ rang sangs rgyas dang sangs rgyas gnyis ni drod rtse gnyis nyan thos kyi lam gyis bgrod nas/ de nas sangs rgyas gnyis kyi lam du sgyur bar byed pa'ang yod mod/ 'dir 'og ma nas rim gyis bshad na/ nyan thos kyi rigs can gyi gang zag rnams rang nyid gcig pu 'khor ba las thar bar bya ba'i sems skyed de/ mthong lam du sdug kun la yid 'byung ba dang / bsgom lam du chags pa dang bral ba dang / nyon mongs las rnam par grol ba'i bsam pas nyan thos kyi sde snod la dmigs nas myang 'das dang rjes su mthun pa'i lam bsgrubs pas khams gsum gyi 'dod chags dang bral te/ lus zhig tshor ba sil bar 'gyur/ /'du shes 'gags shing 'du byed zhig /rnam par shes pa nub gyur pa/ /'di 'dra 'dir ni sdug bsngal mtha'/ /zhes pa'i mtshan nyid can gyis myang 'das mngon du byed par 'dod do/ /nyan thos kyi 'bras bu ni/ myur na tshe gsum la tshogs lam sbyor lam 'phags lam gsum mngon du byed de/ myur ba srid pa gsum gyi mthar/ /zhes so/ /bul ba la ni nges pa med do/ /gnyis pa rang sangs rgyas kyi rigs can ni/ rang bzhin gyis nyon mongs chung bas 'du 'dzi la mi dga' zhing gcig pu la dga' ba dang / snying rje chung bas sems las chung ngur gnas pa la 'jug pa dang / nyan thos kyi sde snod la dmigs nas sangs rgyas mi bzhugs pa'i zhing du sngar bshad pa'i mtshan nyid can gyi byang chub mngon du byed pa ste/ de yang dbang rnon ni bse ru bskal pa brgya yis rgyus zhes pa ltar tshogs bsags pas rgyud smin par byed cing / mkhas bya'i dngos po phung khams dang skye mched dang rten 'brel dang /

gnas dang gnas min pa dang bden pa ste drug la mkhas par byed la/ nges 'byed cha mthun sngon slob dpon la brten pa'i tshe mngon du ma byas par/ sangs rgyas med pa'i zhing du gzhan gyi sgra la ma brten par bdag nyid kyis byang chub mngon du byed par gyur cig ces sogs kyis smon lam btab pas/ srid pa tha mar gyur pa'i dus su bsam gtan bzhi rim gyis bgrod de/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'i rab mtha' la brten nas drod nas zad mi skye shes kyi bar stan thog gcig tu mngon du byas pas bse ru lta bur gyur te gcig pur gnas so/ /dbang po 'bring ni bskal pa brgya tshang bar tshogs gsog pa'i nges pa med cing / nges 'byed cha mthun slob dpon las bskyed nas gnas drug la mkhas pa sogs snga ma ltar byas pas rang rgyal du gyur te tshogs spyod che ba'o/ /dbang rtul gyis ni sangs rgyas mnyes par byed pa sogs kyis sngon dge sbyong gi tshul gyis 'bras bu rgyun zhugs sogs bzhi thob nas/ dngos po drug la mkhas pa sogs snga ma ltar byas pas rang rgyal du gyur te tshogs spyod chung ba'o/ /de gnyis kyis ni nyan thos dang 'dra bar gang zag gi bdag med tsam rtogs la/ bse ru lta bus ni chos bdag gi phyogs gcig gzung bar rang bzhin med par rtogs so zhes nyi 'og pa rnams 'dod la/ kha che ba rnams bse ru lta bu las mi bzhed cing / dngos ma'i lugs la nyan rang la rtogs pa'i khyad par yang mi 'dod ces 'ga' zhig las bshad do/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags te/ gong rang rgyal gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar stan thog gcig tu byang chub mngon du byed pa yin no/ /de yang / ston dang bse ru byang chub bar/ /bsam gtan mtha' rten gcig la kun/ /de yi gong du thar cha mthun/ /zhes sogs kyis so/ /sngar bshad pa'i nyan thos kyi gang zag la dbye na/ so so skye bo dang 'phags pa'i gang zag gnyis kyi dang po la dad pa'i rjes 'brangs dang chos kyi rjes 'brangs gnyis su gnas so/

/'phags pa'i gang zag la zung bzhi dang ya brgyad de/ de'ang mthong spang gi nyon mongs pa spangs pa'i mthong lam skad cig bco lnga po la gnas pa ni rgyun zhugs zhugs pa/ bcu drug la gnas pa ni de'i 'bras gnas/ des 'dod pa'i bsgom spang lnga pa'i bar spangs na phyir 'ong la zhugs pa/ drug pa spangs na de'i 'bras gnas/ bdun pa'am brgyad pa spangs na phyir mi 'ong la zhugs pa/ 'dod pa'i dgu pa spangs na de'i 'bras gnas/ des bsam gtan dang po'i nyon mongs gcig spang pa nas bzung ste/ srid rtse'i bar gyi brgyad pa zad pa na dgra bcom la zhugs pa/ srid rtse'i nyon mongs dgu pa ma lus pa spang ba'i bar chad med lam rdo rje lta bu la gnas pa'ang de yin la/ des rnam grol lam zad pa shes pa thob pa na dgra bcom par 'gyur ro/ /de la dgra bcom dbang po rtul po dran shes bzhin gyis zin rung ma zin rung / mthong chos kyi bder gnas kyi bsam gtan las yongs su nyams pa'i chos can dang / ma shi na mthong chos kyis bder gnas las nyams su dogs pas ma nyams par shi ba rung snyam pa ste 'chi bar bsam pa'i dang / dran shes bzhin gyis zin na mi nyams pas rjes su bsrung ba'i dang / rang gi sems 'bad rtsol gyis dbang po mi sbyong ba/ gnas pa las mi bskyed pa dang / 'bad rtsol gyis dbang po rno bar gtong ba/ rtogs pa'i skal ba can dang / rang bzhin gyis dbang po rno bas ma sbyang kyang dbang po mi nyams pa mi g.yo ba'i chos can drug yod par bshad cing sangs rgyas gnyis kyang phyi ma'i bye brag yin par 'dod/ bzhi pa gang zag rnams kyi shes pa'i dbye ba la/ gsum du bsdu dang bcur dbye ba/ /gang zag gang la ldan pa 'o/ /dang po ni kun rdzob shes pa dang / chos shes pa dang / rjes su shes pa gsum yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ chos shes rjes shes kun rdzob shes/ /pha rol sems shes bden bzhi shes/ /zad dang mi skye shes pa 'o/ /de dag kyang bum snam la sogs pa 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas kyi cha la 'jug pa kun rdzob shes pa/

'dod pa na spyod pa'i sdug bsngal la sogs pa'i bden pa bzhi shes rjes su shes pa/ pha rol gyi sems kyi rnam pa 'dzin pa pha rol gyi sems shes pa/ bden pa bzhi la bcu drug tu phye ba nyid la 'jug pa ni bden pa bzhi shes pa ste/ 'di ni sdug bsngal 'phags pa'i bden pa'o zhes bya ba la sogs pa shes pa'o/ /bdag gis sdug bsngal shes so/ /kun 'byung spangs so/ /'gog pa mngon du byas so/ /lam bsten to zhes bya ba ni zad pa shes pa bdag gis sdug bsngal yongs su shes so/ /shes par byar med do zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni mi skye ba shes pa'o/ /gsum pa la so so skye bo gcig gam gnyis/ mthong bsgom bdun nam brgyad/ dgra bcom bcu ka sangs rgyas thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ so so skye bo nges 'byed cha mthun man chad la ni kun rdzob shes pa gcig pu dang ldan la/ gal te chags bral zhig yin na pha rol gyi sems shes pa dang ldan no/ /gnyis pa'i skabs 'dir dpe rnying kha cig las/ de'ang skad cig dang po la kun rdzob shes pa dang ldan no/ /skad cig gnyis pa la sdug bsngal shes pa dang / chos shes pa dang / kun rdzob shes pa dang ldan no/ /de bzhin du re re bsnan pas bdun du 'gyur la zhes pa 'byung bar bla ma dag gsungs pas dpe de bzhin dag pa yin te/ mdzod las/ zag med skad cig dang po la/ /chags can shes pa gcig dang ldan/ /gnyis pa la gsum de yan chad/ /bzhi la re re 'phel dang ldan/ /zhes bshad pa dang 'grigs pas so/ /de yang re re 'phel tshul ni/ skad cig ma bzhi pa la rjes shes dang / drug pa la kun 'byung shes pa dang / bcu pa la 'gog pa shes pa dang / bcu bzhi pa la lam shes pa ste bzhi po re re 'phel bas skad cig ma bzhi pa la shes pa bzhi dang / drug pa la lnga dang / bcu pa la drug dang / bcu bzhi pa la bdun dang ldan la/ gal te chags bral zhig na thams cad du sems shes pa bsnan pas skad cig dang po la gnyis ldan pa nas/

bcu bzhi pa la brgyad ldan pa'i bar du 'gyur ro/ /bsgom lam pa ni de nyid goms par bya ba yin pas skad cig bcu bzhi pa ltar ldan no/ /dgra bcom pa mi g.yo ba'i chos can gyis ni zad pa shes pas dang mi skye ba shes pa thob pas shes pa bcu ka dang ldan no/ /bzhi pa la sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thun mong ma yin pa dang / gzhan yang thun mong ba'o/ /dang po la/ ma 'dres pa bco brgyad/ mnyam pa dang mi mnyam pa'i cha/ phun sum tshogs pa gsum mo/ /dang po la/ stobs bcu/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi/ dran pa nyer gzhag gsum/ thugs rje chen po'o/ /de'i dang po la/ gnas dang gnas min las kyi rnam smin dang / /mos pa sna tshogs 'jig rten khams rig dang / /dbang po mchog dang mchog min kun 'gro'i lam/ /kun byang dang ni sngon gnas rjes su dran/ /'chi 'pho skye dang zag zad mkhyen pa 'o/ /de'ang sbyin pa las longs spyod 'byung ba gnas dang ser sna las de 'byung ba gnas ma yin pa sogs kun byang gis bsdus pa'i rgyu 'bras kyi yul la chags thogs med pa'i mkhyen pa dang / de bzhin du sbyar te dge sdig gi las kyi ngo bo dang rab dbye rgya chen po la dang / byang chub gsum don du gnyer ba'i mos pa'am 'dod pa sna tshogs la dang / gdul bya'i 'jig rten gyi khams te rigs sna tshogs la nges pa dang ma nges pa'i yul la dang / gdul bya dbang po mchog rnon po dang / mchog ma yin pa rtul 'bring rnams kyi rnam dbye la dang / mngon mtho dang nges legs kun tu 'gro ba'i lam theg pa gsum dang bsod nams dang mi g.yo ba'i las dang / de las bzlog pa la dang / bsam gtan dang rnam thar dang snyoms 'jug sogs kyi kun nyon gyi ro myang dang nyes dmigs sogs dang rnam byang de la dmigs shing nges par 'byung ba la dang / rang gzhan gyi sngon gyi gnas kyi tshe rabs du ma rjes su dran pa la dang / 'gro ba kun da lta nas ma 'ongs par 'jug pa'i 'chi 'pho dang skye ba'i gnas skabs la dang /

nyan rang rnams sgrib pa phyogs gcig gis dag la sangs rgyas mtha' dag pa'i gnas skabs la chags thogs med pa'i mkhyen pa ste bcu po 'di rnams mi mthun pa'i phyogs kyis mi brdzi ba'i phyir stobs zhes bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rtogs dang spangs pa phun tshogs zhal gyis bzhes/ /bar chad chos dang nges 'byin lam ston pa'o/ /de dag kyang 'khor gyi dbus su nga ni chos thams cad rnam pa thams cad du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so zhes zhal gyis bzhes pa rtogs pa phun tshogs la mi 'jigs pa'i rnam pa dang / nga ni sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa spangs so zhes bdag nyid zag pa ma lus pa zad par zhal gyis bzhes pa spangs pa phun tshogs la mi 'jigs pa'i rnam pa dang / 'dod chags la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa rnams ni thar pa la bar du gcod pa'o zhes rang gi nyan thos la ston pa/ bar gcod kyi chos ston pa la mi 'jigs pa'i rnam pa dang / 'khor ba la nges par 'byin pa'i lam rnams byang chub gsum du nges par 'byung ba nyid du ston pa nges 'byung gi lam ston pa la mi 'jigs pa'i rnam pa ste snga ma gnyis rang don dang / phyi ma gnyis gzhan don gyi dbang du byas pa ste/ de ltar zhal gyis bzhes pa la chos mthun gyi rgol ba med cing zhum pa med par byed pa'i phyir mi 'jigs pa'o/ /gsum pa ni 'khor gus par chos nyan pa la rjes su chags pa dang / ma gus par chos nyan pa la khong khro ba dang / 'dres ma la gnyis kar mi 'gyur bar dran pa dang shes bzhin du btang snyoms su bzhugs pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ 'gro ba kun la dmigs nas thugs rje chen pos nyin mtshan dus drug du yang dag par gzigs nas sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa las sgrol bar bzhed pa ste/ 'jig rten kun la nyin mtshan du/ /lan drug tu ni so sor gzigs/ /thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa/ /phan dgongs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /de yang / sangs rgyas chos ni ma 'dres pa/

/stobs la sogs pa bco brgyad do/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyang rgyu tshogs gnyis 'grub pa dang / 'bras bu chos sku yongs su 'grub pa dang / 'phrin las 'gro ba'i don spyod pa ste rgyu gsum gyis mnyam la 'on kyang sku tshe ring thung dang rgyal rigs la sogs pa'i rigs dang / sku bong che chung rnams tha dad pas de gsum gyis mi mnyam pa ste/ sangs rgyas thams cad tshogs dang ni/ /chos sku 'gro ba'i don spyod la/ /mnyam pa nyid de sku tshe dang / /rigs dang sku bong tshad kyis min/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa la/ rgyu 'bras phan 'dogs phun tshogs so/ /dang po ni grangs med gsum du bar chad med par tshogs gnyis goms par byas pa ste/ 'phags pas/ dang po byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed nas/ /bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags te/ /bar du gcod pa'i bdud bzhi 'joms mdzad pa/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa la/ ye shes spangs pa mthu dang gzugs sku'o/ /dang po ni/ ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa spangs pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ gdul bya mngon mtho dang nges legs la 'god par mdzad pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa'i sku mngon du 'gyur pa'o/ /gsum pa phan 'dogs phun tshogs ni gdul bya rnams ngan song dang 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las thar bar mdzad pa ste/ theg pa gsum gyi 'bras bu'am bde 'gro la 'god par mdzad pa'o// //spyi don gnyis pa thun mong pa la/ nyan thos dang thun mong ba dang / 'jig rten pa dang thun mong pa'o/ /dang po la/ nyon mongs med dang smon gnas shes/ /yang dag rigs bzhi mngon shes so/ /dang po ni/ nyan rang sogs bsod snyoms sogs la rgyu ba'i sngon du 'ga' zhig bdag la dmigs nas nyon mongs pa skye bar mi 'gyur ram zhes mngon shes kyis brtags nas/ skye bar shes na bdag la dmigs nas nyon mongs skye bar ma gyur cig snyam du nyon mongs med pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par 'jug la/

de'i stobs kyis bdag la dmigs pa'i nyon mongs mi skye ba tsam byed la/ sangs rgyas kyis ni gang gi bdag la dmigs nas nyon mongs skye ba de'i nyon mongs drungs nas 'byin pa'i 'phrin las mdzad pas snga ma las khyad par 'phags so/ /gnyis pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi smon gnas mkhyen pa ni nyan rang gi las khyad par lngas khyad par 'phags te/ 'bad rtsol med par lhun gyis grub pa dang / ngo bo gang la'ang ma zhen pas chags pa spangs pa dang / sgrib gnyis spangs pas yul kun la thogs pa med pa dang / 'khor ba ji srid par rtag tu gnas pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa'i sgo nas gdul bya'i dri ba kun la lan 'debs pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ kun byang chos rnams kyi ming gi rnam grangs du ma dang / gzugs nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar gyi chos rnams kyi rang dang spyi'i mtshan nyid dang / yul gyi mi skad so so ji snyed pa dang / chos rnams kyi ngo bo dang rnam pa'i rab dbye mtha' yas pa'i yul la chags thogs med par 'jug pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab ni go rim bzhin du chos don nges tshig spobs pa rnams la thogs pa med pa'i so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi'o/ /bzhi pa ni de ma thag tu 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa la/ mngon shes bsam gzugs tshad med dang / /rnam par zil gnon zad par ro/ /dang po la/ rdzu 'phrul lha yi rna mig dang / /sngon gnas rjes dran gzhan sems shes/ /'chi 'pho skye ba zag pa zad/ /mngon par shes pa rnam pa drug /dang po ni/ gcig tu bsdus shing mang por bsgyur ba la sogs pa byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'jig rten gyi khams kyi gzugs sgra bskal pa dang ma bskal pa thams cad thos shing mthong ba sogs bsgom gyis byung ba mnyam gzhag gi sas bsdus pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ rang gzhan gyi tshe rabs snga ma rjes su dran pa'i ting shes mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni/

gang zag gzhan gyis sems 'dod chags dang bcas pa sogs ji lta ba bzhin du shes pa'i ting shes mtshungs bcas so/ /lnga pa ni/ 'gro ba kun da lta nas ma 'ongs par 'jug pa'i gnas skabs thams cad shes pa'i ting shes mtshungs bcas sam/ yang na 'di nyid lha'i mig gi mngon shes su bya ste gzhung phal cher las de 'byung ngo / /drug pa ni/ sgrib pa spang ba'i thabs dang / de dag spangs pa'i rnam grol ji lta ba bzhin du shes pa'i ting shes mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa ste snga ma lnga ni nyan rang dang 'jig rten pa gnyis ka dang thun mong ba yin la/ phyi ma ni nyan rang dang thun mong pa'o/ /gnyis pa dang gsum pa ni bsam gtan bzhi dang gzugs med dang 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug rnams snga ma snga ma thob par byas nas/ phyi ma phyi ma la snyoms par 'jug pa mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa thob pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni sems can rnams la bde ba dang phan pa'i dgongs pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ tshad med snga ma gsum ste/ byams pas bde ba dang phrad pa/ snying rjes sdug bsngal dang bral ba/ dga' bas bde ba dang mi 'bral ba yin la/ btang snyoms te khong khro dang rjes chags kyi kun nyon gnyis ka med par bzhed pas phan pa'i dgongs pa ste bzhi'o/ /lnga pa la/ gzugs can gzugs la lta ba'i rnam thar ni/ bsam gtan bzhi la brten nas nang lta ba po bdag la gzugs su 'du shes bzhag ste/ phyi rol gyi gzugs che chung bzang ngan sogs la che chung bzang ngan las bzlog ste lta ba sogs gang dang gang sprul par 'dod pa la de dang der mos pa bya ba'i ting shes mtshungs bcas so/ /nang gzugs med par phyi rol gyi gzugs la blta ba'i rnam thar ni/ nang lta ba po bdag la gzugs can ma yin pa'i 'du shes bzhag ste/ phyi rol gyi gzugs la snga ma bzhin du blta ba dang / sdug pa'i rnam thar lus kyis mngon sum du byas te gnas pa ni/ sdug mi sdug sprul pa la 'dod mi 'dod sogs kun nyon gyi gnyen por sdug mi sdug sogs phan tshun ltos pa'i 'du shes dang /

phan tshun rjes su 'brel ba'i 'du shes dang / rnam pa thams cad sdug pa ro gcig tu mos pa'i ting shes mtshungs bcas so/ /nam mkha' mtha' yas sogs gzugs med kyi rnam thar bzhi ni 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug ste 'du shes dang tshor ba 'gog pa'i sgrib pa las grol ba'i phyir rnam thar du bzhag go /drug pa la bsam gtan la brten nas nang gzugs med par 'du shes pas phyi rol gyi gzugs chung ngu dag la de ltar blta zhing zil gyis mnan nas shes zil gyis mnan nas mthong ba ni zil gnon gyi skye mched dang po'o/ /gzugs chung ngu'i gnas su chen po sbyar ba ni gnyis pa'o/ /nang gzugs su 'du shes pas phyi rol gyi gzugs chung ngu dag la snga ma ltar blta ba ni gsum pa'o/ /chung ngu'i gnas su chen po sbyar ba ni bzhi pa'o/ /nang gzugs med par 'du shes pas phyi rol gyi gzugs kha dog sngon po lta bur ston pa 'od sngon po 'byung ba rnams la blta ste/ gzugs de dag zil gyis mnan nas shes/ zil gyis mnan nas mthong ba ni lnga pa'o/ /de bzhin du ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po rnams la'ang ci rigs par sbyar bas kha dog zil gyis gnon pa'i skye mched bzhi ste zil gnon brgyad do/ /bdun pa la/ 'byung bzhi'i zad par ni bsam gtan la brten nas mtha' dag 'byung ba de dang der mos pa byas te bsgoms pa las 'byung ba de dang der snang zhing sprul par byed pa'i ting shes so/ /sngo ser dmar dkar te kha dog gi bzhi yang bsam gtan la brten nas mtha' dag sngon po la sogs pa de dang der snang ba'i ting shes so/ /nam mkha' dang rnam shes kyi zad par ni nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched dang / rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched la brten nas mtha' dag nam mkha' dang rnam shes su snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab ste zad par bcu'o// //spyi don lnga pa ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par la/ ming don rdzas su dbye ba dang /

/grub tshul rigs can grol tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ dge ba'i sems rtse gcig pa ste/ /snyoms 'jug dge ba rtse gcig pa/ /zhes so/ /ting 'dzin de nyid yan lag dang ldan zhing zhi lhag zung du 'brel ba ni yid mi g.yo bar 'dzin pa bsam gtan dang / dmigs pa la mnyam par 'jog pas snyoms 'jug ces bya'o/ /de'ang las kyi dbang gis der skyes pa na bsam gtan zhes bya ba nyid yin la/ rnal 'byor pa rnams de lta bu la 'jug pa rnams ni yon tan thams cad kyi rten du gyur pa'i phyir snyoms par 'jug pa zhes bya'o/ /gnyis pa la bsam gtan bzhi dang gzugs med bzhi las/ dang po ni/ gzugs med rnams kyang yon tan gyi rten yin mod kyi/ yon tan thams cad kyi rten ma yin la/ yon tan thams cad kyi rten du gyur pa ni bsam gtan rnams te/ de yang 'bras bu skye ba dang rgyu snyoms 'jug gi dbye bas rnam pa gnyis yin la/ de dag kyang dang po la sogs pa'i dbye bas bzhi ste/ bsam gtan dag ni rnam gnyis bzhi/ /zhes so/ /de bzhin gzugs med rnams kyang 'bras bu rgyu'i dbye bas gnyis dang / de'ang nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched la sogs pa'i dbye bas bzhi ste/ de bzhin gzugs med ces so/ /gsum pa ni/ ting 'dzin 'di dag zag pa dang bcas pas bsgoms na 'khor ba'i 'bras bu 'jig rten pa'i bsam gtan tsam yin la/ zag med de lam gyi bden pa dang ldan pas bsgoms na rnam par grol ba'i myang 'das thob pas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i snyoms 'jug ces bya'o/ /bzhi pa ni dge ba'i rtsa ba ci rigs pa dro bar gyur pa nas brtsams te/ dgra bcom pa mi g.yo ba'i chos can gyi bar la rim gyis khyad par du 'phags pa'i tshul gyis yod la/ mi g.yo ba'i chos can ni bsam gtan bzhi pa la brten nas mya ngan las 'das pa yul lnga dang / 'dus byas kyi mtshan nyid bzhi dang / pho mo'i mtshan ma ste bcu dang bral ba'i phyir mtshan ma med pa/

bdag med dang stong nyid mtshungs par ldan pas stong pa nyid lam yang gzings lta bur 'bor ba'i phyir smon pa med pa ste/ rnam thar sgo gsum gyi ting nge 'dzin 'di nas mya ngan las 'das pa zhes bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das ni rdo rje gdan du nyon mongs pa dang lha'i bu'i bdud btul/ yangs pa can du 'chi bdag gi bdud btul/ rtsa mchog gi grong du phung po'i bdud btul ba yin no zhes zer ro/ /mdor na zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gis gzhi byas pa'i ting nge 'dzin de dag dang / shes bya'i dkyil 'khor sbyangs pa dang bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya che chung gi khyad par la brten nas rigs can gsum gyi 'bras bu tha dad par 'byung ba yin no/ /'di'i grub mtha' zhib tu shes par 'dod pas mngon pa mdzod blta bar bya'o/ /byang phyogs la sogs pa'i sdom rnams ma gtogs shes byed du drangs pa'i lung gi khungs ma smos pa rnams kyang phal cher mdzod kyi lung yin no/ /zhes pa de rnams bye brag tu smra ba'i grub mtha'i rnam gzhag bshad zin to/ /'dir smras pa/ de ltar bye brag smra gzhung grub pa'i mtha'/ /de nyid 'di zhes snying po bsdus pa'i tshul/ /de dag nges nas lugs 'di'i gsung rab tshogs/ /de kun khong du chud la dka' ba ci/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// //spyi don gnyis pa mdo sde pa'i grub mtha' bshad pa la gnyis te/ tshigs bcad kyi sgo nas mdor bstan pa dang / de'i don rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ de ltar bye brag smra ba'i gzhung nges nas/ /mdo sde pa yi gzhung lugs rig par bya/ /de la snga ma'i log rtog dgag pa ni/ /mdo las bstan bcos gtsor byed rigs min te/ /gsung pa po la gus pa lhod 'gyur zhing / /bstan bcos nyid kyang mdo la brten phyir ro/ /mngon sum rjes su dpag pas grub min pas/ /brtan med thogs med rnam rig min gzugs dang / /mi ldan 'du byed rdzas su yod ma yin/

/'das dang ma 'ongs 'gags dang ma skyes med/ /yod na da lta nyid du thal bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin 'dus ma byas pa'i chos rnams kun/ /rkyen gyis ma bskyed phyir na rdzas su med/ /phyi rol yul gyi rnam pa ma shar bar/ /dus mnyam thug phrad 'dzin pa'ang rigs min te/ /rnam pa med na sngo ser la sogs pa/ /rtogs tshul so sor dbye bar mi nus phyir/ /de nas rang lugs mdo bzhin 'chad pa la/ /bshad bya gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis te/ /de dag brjod bya'i sgo nas bslab pa gsum/ /ston phyir sde snod gsum du 'dus par 'dod/ /rnam rig min gzugs mi ldan 'du byed dang / /chos kyi khams dang chos kyi skye mched kyi/ /phyogs re ma gtogs phung khams skye mched gzhan/ /mtha' dag 'dir yang rdzas su yod par 'dod/ /ji ltar snang ba shes pa nyid yin yang / /snang ba'i rgyu ni phyi don yin par 'dod/ /gzung 'dzin dus snyoms min phyir rang 'dzin la/ /rang 'dra'i rnam pa gtod byed lkog na mo/ /des na shes pas don dngos ma rig kyang / /rnam pa snang ba'i dbang gis rig par bzhag /de phyir dmigs yul phyi rol don yin yang / /myong ba'i yul ni shes pa nyid yin phyir/ /ngo bo rang rig yin yang phyi rol gyi/ /don dang 'dra bar skyes phyir don rig brjod/ /sems dang sems byung rang gsal skad cig ma/ /mi ldan 'du byed gzugs sems sems byung gi /gnas skabs 'ga' la btags pa tsam du 'dod/ /de bzhin 'dus ma byas pa btags pa tsam/ /mya ngan 'das pa'ang dngos por med par 'dod/ /lam dang gang zag rnam dbye phal che ba/ /bye brag smra ba'i 'dod pa dang mthun yang / /byang chub sems dpa' rnams la sa bcu dang / /rdzogs sangs rgyas la sku gsum la sogs 'dod/ /de dag ston byed mdo sde 'chad tshul ni/ /nyan po gus pa bskyed phyir dgos don bshad/ /gzhung don rags pa rtogs phyir bsdus don bstan/ /bya byed las gsum sbyar la tshig don blang /

/snga phyi'i 'brel pa rtogs phyir mtshams sbyar nas/ /rtogs pa'i sgo rnams brgal lan sgo nas bsnyad/ /ces tshigs su bcad pa'i sgo nas mdo sde pa'i gzhung lugs mdor bstan nas/ gnyis pa de'i don rgyas par bshad pa la/ bye smra sun 'byung ba dang / rang lugs brjod pa gnyis las/ /dang po la/ bye smras log par brtags pa mang du yod kyang / bsdu na/ mdo bas bstan bcos tshad mar byed pa dang / gzhi lnga char rdzas su yod par 'dod pa'o/ /dang po mi 'thad de/ bstan bcos mdzad pa po dgra bcom de dag shes sgrib ma spangs pas 'khrul pa srid pa'i phyir dang / gsung ba po ston pa la ma gus par 'gyur ba'i phyir dang / slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis/ bstan bcos dang 'gal ba ni sla yi/ mdo dang 'gal ba ni de ltar ma yin no zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /ma yin te/ mdo ni gdul bya la dgongs te gsungs pa mang bas drang don shas che'o snyam na/ 'o na bstan bcos nyid kyang bka' la brten nas byas pas bstan bcos kyang spang dgos par 'gyur ro/ /khyed rang gi grub mtha' ston pa'i gzhung las kyang / spyod pa rnams kyi gnyen por ni/ /chos kyi phung po mthun par gsungs/ /zhes sogs bshad pa ma yin nam/ des na bka' thams cad ni gdul bya'i ngor gsungs pas legs par gsungs pa kho na'o/ /gnyis pa ni de la rdzas su yod pa de ci/ de tha snyad du brjod du rung ba'i ngo bo tsam la bya'am/ rang gi mtshan nyid kyis yod pa la bya/ dang po ltar na btags yod gtan mi srid par 'gyur ro/ /gal te gnyis pa la yin no zhe na/ phyi rol gyi don khas len pa'i dbang du byas nas/ rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs ma gtogs gzugs dang sems dang sems las byung ba'i gzhi ni rdzas su yod pa bden na/ rnam rig min gzugs dang / mi ldan pa'i 'du byed dang 'dus ma byas rdzas su yod par ga la 'gyur te/ bstan med thogs med kyi rnam rig min gzugs rdzas grub tu yod na/

gzhig cing gzhom du rung ba gzugs kyi mtshan nyid du mi rung ba'i phyir dang / rdul phran ma bsags pa'i bems po srid par thal ba'i phyir mngon sum gyis mi 'grub la/ phyogs gang du'ang mi dmigs shing / don gang dang yang ma 'brel ba'i phyir rjes su dpag pas kyang mi 'grub ste/ tsan+d+ra ha ris rin chen phreng ba las/ bstan med thogs med rnam rig min/ /de phyir mngon sum gyis mi 'grub/ /phyogs 'gar ma grub 'brel mi 'grub/ /de phyir rjes su dpag pas min/ /sgrub byed med la gnod mthong phyir/ /de phyir rnam rig min gzugs med/ /ces so/ /mi ldan pa'i 'du byed thob pa la sogs pa'ang gzugs sems sems las byung ba'i gnas skabs kyi chos la btags pa tsam yin te/ de ma yin na gzugs sems sems byung gsum las rdzas gzhan yin nam/ de dag nyid yin legs par dpyod la de yod pa'i rang bzhin ston cig de ni rdzas grub tu sngon rjes gang gis kyang bstan par mi nus so/ /gzhan yang skye ba sogs kyang rdzas su yod pa'i phyir dus gsum yang der thal lo/ /'dod na 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa da ltar du yod pa'i phyir 'das pa ma 'ongs pa ma yin par 'gyur ro/ /de dag kyang rin phreng las/ gzugs dang sems dang sems byung gi /gnas skabs la btags mi ldan byed/ /de las gzhan yang de nyid yin/ /de las gzhan na mngon sum pa'o/ /sgrub byed med pa gong bzhin du/ /'grub pa la dngos yod ces pa'i/ /tha snyad mkhas pa rung ma yin/ /de nyid yin na legs bshad ci/ /zhes so/ /yang 'dus ma byas rdzas su yod na mya ngan las 'das pa'ang rdzas su yod par thal lo/ /de 'dod na/ mar me shi ba ji bzhin du/ /de yis sems kyang rnam par thar/ /zhes sogs dang 'gal lo/ /de na 'dus ma byas rdzas grub mi rigs te/ rgyu med pa'i phyir de nyid las/ /'gog sogs 'dus ma byas rnams ni/ /rgyu med phyir na rta ru bzhin/

/rkyen dang mi ldan dngos po ni/ /'ga' yang gang na'ang rung ba min/ /zhes so/ /phyi rol gyi don rnam pa ma shar bzhin du dus mnyam thug phrad du rig par 'dod pa'ang mi rigs te/ rnam pa med na 'di'i sngon po rtogs la/ 'di'i ser po rtogs zhes dbye bar mi nus par 'gyur la/ sngo sogs kyi rnam pa ma shar zhing rig tsam du yul kun la mtshungs pa'i phyir te/ rnam 'grel las/ rang spyod yul gyi phye med cing / /tha dad par myong med de la/ /'di ni 'di ltar 'di ltar ni/ /min zhes tha dad 'di mi 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /rang rig med pa'ang mi 'thad de/ /dran pa las kyang bdag rig grub/ /ces gsungs pas/ rang yod dus na nyams su myong ba las dran par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa rang lugs gzhag pa la/ mdo'i rab tu dbye ba/ mdo'i don gtan la dbab pa/ mdo'i tshig bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ snying po mchog las/ mdo sde dbyangs bsnyad lung bstan dang / /tshigs bcad ched brjod gleng gzhi dang / /rtogs brjod de lta bu byung dang / /skyes rabs shin tu rgyas pa dang / /rmad byung gtan la phab pa'i sde/ /gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis yin/ /zhes so/ /de rnams kyi ngos 'dzin ni/ mdo sde tshig lhug don mang ston/ /dbyangs bsnyad dbus mthar tshigs bcad gsungs/ /lung bstan 'das dang 'byung ba ston/ /tshigs bcad rkang mnyam sbyar nas gsungs/ /ched brjod ma zhus yi rang gsungs/ /gleng gzhi bslab pa bcas pa brjod/ /rtogs brjod don gsal dper bcas gsungs/ /de ltar bu byung sngon byung brjod/ /skyes rabs sngon gyi mdzad pa ston/ /shin rgyas zab rgyas theg pa ston/ /rmad byung 'phags pa'i ngo mtshar gtam/ /gtan phab mtshan nyid ston pa 'o/ /zhes bya'o/ /de rnams kyang brjod bya'i khyad par nas bslab pa gsum ston pas sde snod gsum du 'gyur la/ rjod byed kyi khyad par nas gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis su 'gyur ro/

/de dag kyang theg pa che chung gnyis su 'byed de/ mdo sde dbyangs bsnyad lung bstan dang / /tshigs bcad ched brjod de lnga ni/ /nyan thos kyi mdo sde/ gleng gzhi dang rtogs brjod de lta bu byung gsum ni nyan thos kyi 'dul ba/ skyes rabs ni byang sems kyi 'dul ba/ shin tu rgyas pa dang rmad du byung ba'i chos kyi sde gnyis byang sems kyi mdo sde/ gtan la phab pa'i sde ni gnyis ka'i chos mngon pa'i sde snod yin la/ rang sangs rgyas la sde snod la sogs pa med pas nyan thos kyi sde snod la dmigs pa yin no/ /gnyis pa la ji snyed pa dang ji lta ba'o/ /dang po ni/ phung khams skye mched kyi rnam par gzhag pa ste/ phal cher bye brag tu smra ba dang mthun la/ 'di nyid kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i 'dod pa ni/ tshor 'du rnam shes kyi phung po gsum dang / gzugs dang 'du byed kyi phal cher re dang / chos kyi khams dang chos kyi skye mched kyi phyogs gcig ma gtogs pa khams phyed dang bco brgyad dang / skye mched phyed dang bcu gnyis rdzas grub tu 'dod la/ 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa 'gags shing ma skyes pas da ltar ba kho na rdzas su yod pa dang / rnam par rig byed ma yin pa gzugs su mi 'dod cing / sdom pa la sogs pa sems pa grogs dang bcas par 'dod de/ rin phreng las/ 'di nyid phung po lnga nyid tsam/ /'das dang ma 'ongs 'gags ma skyes/ /ming de da ltar rdzas su yod/ /rig byed ma yin gzugs mi 'dod/ /sdom sogs 'du byed sems pa ni/ /grogs dang bcas par yin par 'dod/ /ces dang / ye shes snying po las/ dus gsum rjes 'gro dag kyang med/ /thogs pa med pa'i gzugs yod min/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ji lta ba bzhin du yod pa ni/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dang / stong nyid bcu drug dang / dge mi dge lung ma bstan gyi de bzhin nyid gsum dang / phyag rgya bzhi dang / rnam thar sgo gsum rnams gtan la 'bebs pa ste/
